raw.description:
Das sind Deine Aufgaben:

  • Du analysierst bereits etablierte zirkuläre Plattformgeschäftsmodelle und leitest Erfolgsfaktoren für Aufbau und Skalierung zirkulärer Plattformen ab
  • Du identifizierst Rollen, Geschäftsmodelle sowie Governance‑Mechanismen für das Plattformökosystem
  • Du modellierst ein skalierbares Plattformökosystem mit klaren Rollen, Interaktionen und Datenflüssen
  • Du entwickelst ein praxisnahes Vorgehensmodell zum Aufbau zirkulärer Plattformgeschäftsmodelle
  • Du validierst dein Modell in Workshops oder Experteninterviews mit namhaften Industrie‑ und Forschungspartnern

Das bringst Du mit:

  • Du studierst Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Maschinenbau, Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Informatik oder ähnliches
  • Du zeichnest Dich durch unternehmerisches Denken aus und hast idealerweise bereits darin erste Projekterfahrungen sammeln können
  • Dich zeichnet eine selbstständige und engagierte sowie sorgfältige und zielorientierte Arbeitsweise aus
  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
  • Du bist sicher im Umgang mit den gängigen MS-Office-Programmen

Das kannst Du erwarten:

  • Einblicke in das Industrie- und Forschungsgeschäft in Zusammenarbeit mit renommierten Unternehmen und Forschungspartnerinnen und -partnern
  • interessante, anspruchsvolle und abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben in einem qualifizierten und dynamischen Team
  • die Möglichkeit zu flexibler Zeiteinteilung und eigenständigem Arbeiten
  • ein modernes, kollegiales und digitales Arbeitsumfeld
  • Raum für Kreativität und Deine persönliche Weiterentwicklung

2015 riefen Parker und Van Alstyne die „Platform Revolution“ aus. Seither haben digitale Plattformen komplette Industrien in kürzester Zeit transformiert. Genau dieses disruptive Potenzial kann zum Katalysator der Circular Economy werden: Marktplätze und Sharing‑Plattformen wie Too Good To Go oder Metcycle zeigen bereits, wie Plattformen die zirkuläre Transformation beschleunigen können. Während Sharing‑Modelle sowie Reuse‑ und Recycling‑Ansätze bereits intensiv untersucht sind, fehlt es bislang an Wissen zu digitalen Plattformen für höherwertige Strategien wie Remanufacturing oder Upgrades. In dieser Abschlussarbeit analysierst du bestehende Plattformlösungen, identifizierst Best Practices und modellierst die Interaktionen der Akteure in einem skalierbaren Plattformökosystem. Am Ende entsteht ein Vorgehensmodell, das zeigt, wie digitale Plattformen ökologischen Impact und wirtschaftliche Attraktivität gleichermaßen steigern können.

raw.excerpt: Position SummaryThe Chief API Officer (CAPIO) is responsible for establishing and executing the organization's Application Programming Interface (API) strategy, governance, and ecosystem development initiatives.
raw.description:
Position Summary

The Chief API Officer (CAPIO) is responsible for establishing and executing the organization's Application Programming Interface (API) strategy, governance, and ecosystem development initiatives. This executive leads API product management, developer experience, platform integration, Open Banking/Open Finance initiatives, API monetization, security, and digital ecosystem expansion. The role serves as the bridge between business strategy and technology innovation, ensuring APIs become strategic assets that drive revenue, partnerships, customer engagement, and digital transformation.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership

  • Develop and execute the enterprise-wide API strategy aligned with business objectives.
  • Establish APIs as strategic products and revenue-generating assets.
  • Drive API-first and platform-centric business models across the organization.
  • Identify opportunities for ecosystem expansion through API enablement.
  • Advise executive leadership and the Board on API innovation and digital ecosystem trends.

API Product Management

  • Oversee the API lifecycle from design and development to deployment and retirement.
  • Define API product roadmaps and service portfolios.
  • Ensure APIs meet customer, developer, and partner requirements.
  • Drive adoption of API product management best practices.
  • Establish service-level agreements (SLAs) and performance standards.

API Governance & Architecture

  • Develop API governance frameworks, standards, and policies.
  • Establish enterprise API architecture and design principles.
  • Ensure consistency, scalability, and interoperability across API platforms.
  • Oversee API versioning, documentation, and lifecycle management.
  • Promote API reuse and enterprise integration strategies.

Developer Ecosystem & Partnerships

  • Build and manage developer communities and partner ecosystems.
  • Develop API onboarding programs and developer support initiatives.
  • Foster innovation through open APIs and third-party integrations.
  • Collaborate with external developers, fintechs, vendors, and strategic partners.
  • Lead developer experience (DX) improvements.

API Monetization & Commercial Strategy

  • Develop API monetization models and pricing strategies.
  • Create new revenue streams through API products and services.
  • Identify commercial partnership opportunities leveraging APIs.
  • Monitor API usage, consumption trends, and profitability.
  • Support marketplace and ecosystem expansion strategies.

Open Banking & Open Finance Leadership

  • Lead Open Banking, Open Finance, and Embedded Finance API initiatives.
  • Ensure compliance with industry standards and regulatory requirements.
  • Drive innovation through financial data-sharing ecosystems.
  • Develop strategic API partnerships with financial institutions and fintech organizations.

Security, Risk & Compliance

  • Ensure API security and data protection standards are maintained.
  • Oversee authentication, authorization, and access management frameworks.
  • Implement API cybersecurity best practices.
  • Ensure compliance with privacy regulations, industry standards, and regulatory requirements.
  • Manage operational, security, and third-party risks.

Technology & Innovation

  • Drive adoption of modern API technologies and integration platforms.
  • Oversee API gateways, management platforms, and developer portals.
  • Support cloud-native architectures and microservices transformation.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies including AI, blockchain, and event-driven architectures.
  • Promote continuous innovation and automation.

Data & Analytics

  • Monitor API performance and business outcomes.
  • Establish API analytics and reporting frameworks.
  • Utilize data insights to optimize API products and customer experiences.
  • Measure ecosystem growth and API adoption metrics.

Team Leadership

  • Build and lead high-performing API product, engineering, architecture, and developer relations teams.
  • Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and customer-centricity.
  • Develop future leaders and technical experts within the API organization.

Required Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business Administration, or related field.
  • MBA or Master's degree preferred.

Experience

  • 12+ years of leadership experience in API management, enterprise architecture, digital platforms, software engineering, fintech, or technology sectors.
  • Proven experience developing and managing enterprise API ecosystems.
  • Strong background in Open Banking, Open Finance, platform strategies, or digital transformation initiatives.
  • Experience leading large-scale integration and developer ecosystem programs.

Technical Knowledge

  • API Design & Architecture
  • REST, GraphQL, gRPC, and Event-Driven APIs
  • API Gateways & Management Platforms
  • Open Banking & Open Finance Standards
  • Cloud Computing & Microservices
  • Enterprise Integration
  • Cybersecurity & Identity Management
  • Developer Portals & Developer Experience
  • Data Governance & Privacy
  • Platform & Ecosystem Management

Core Competencies

  • API Strategy & Governance
  • Platform & Ecosystem Development
  • API Product Management
  • Digital Transformation Leadership
  • API Monetization
  • Developer Experience (DX)
  • Security & Risk Management
  • Innovation & Emerging Technologies
  • Stakeholder Engagement
  • Executive Leadership

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • API adoption and consumption growth.
  • API revenue and monetization performance.
  • Number of active developers and partners.
  • API platform uptime and reliability.
  • Time-to-market for API products.
  • Security and compliance performance.
  • Customer and developer satisfaction scores.
  • API transaction volume growth.
  • Ecosystem expansion metrics.
  • Operational efficiency and cost optimization.

raw.description:
Role Description

The Diagnostics Technical Support Representative supports end users, field representatives, and distribution partners by resolving issues across a portfolio of animal health diagnostic products. This includes guidance on product operation, applications, configuration, connectivity, and system integration, as well as product-specific troubleshooting for more complex concerns.

The Diagnostics Technical Support Representative participates in all phases of the support process, including handling inbound calls, documenting complaints, driving issue resolution and process improvements. This role requires strong technical expertise and customer service skills to ensure optimal performance and a consistently positive customer experience across veterinary clinics, laboratory research, and academic settings.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Respond promptly and accurately to high volumes of technical support requests through multiple support channels.
  • Diagnose and resolve issues related to product performance, applications, areas of connectivity, and operations. Utilize support tools including but not limited to: back offices, command center, chemistry translator, virtual share, remote in to identify error trends and isolate root cause of issues.
  • Support customers, field force, distributors, and strategic partners by answering technical inquiries, addressing performance issues, and providing application, connectivity, and operations training.
  • Collaborate with Supervisors, Senior Agent, Level 1 Support, Level 2 Support, Level 3 Support, Product Management, Repair, Engineering, Product Support, Quality, VMRD, Field Sales, Field Tech Services, Customer Service, Training team, and VMIPS to deliver seamless support.
  • Document all interactions and resolutions accurately and promptly in the Customer Relationship Management system. Manage the end to end case handling and case management including case processing for reporting to regulatory authorities. Adhere to case management guidelines to ensure key performance indicators and service levels are met.
  • Exercise judgement and autonomy when handling customer dissatisfaction complaint. Review available account information and data to address and resolve customers concerns. Leverage available Tech Support policies or procedures to address customer concerns. Handle escalations through defined pathways as needed. Consult and communicate to internal teams as need to ensure customer retention.
  • Initiate product returns (replacement, investigation, repair) within the Customer Relationship Management system.
  • Process orders to enable troubleshooting, replace defective products, and provide customer accommodation.
  • Maintain up-to-date expertise on diagnostic product lines, troubleshooting methods, policies and procedures.
  • Adhere to Zoetis policies, procedures, and objectives.
  • Participate in special projects and assignments as needed.
  • Manage the RMA process end-to-end.
  • Conduct proactive follow-up calls for new installations as part of customer onboarding.
  • May participate in meetings with local markets

ORGANIZATIONAL RELATIONSHIPS

This position regularly interacts with Supervisors, Senior Agent, Level 1 Support, Level 2 Support, Level 3 Support, Repair, Product Support, Quality, Field Sales, Field Tech Services, Customer Service and Training team. External interactions include communication with veterinary clinics, laboratories, distributors, and strategic partners.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

An equivalent combination of education, training, and experience will be considered.

  • Associates degree in related technical field or Vet Tech degree preferred; equivalent experience considered in lieu of degree
  • 3+ years of experience (Customer Support, Technical Support, Veterinary Technology, IT Support) with at least 1 year of Technical Support experience
  • Point of care diagnostic experience preferred
  • Experience with CRM systems, ERP systems, PIMS and contact center telephone systems highly preferred
  • German is required. English is mandatory for all international agents. Proficiency in additional core European languages (e.g., Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese, Greek, Dutch, Polish) is a strong advantage for this role.

TECHNICAL SKILLS REQUIRE

  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite (Access, Excel, Word, Outlook) and web-based mail systems.
  • Proficient in CRM systems, ERP systems, and contact center telephone systems
  • Excellent telephone etiquette and communication skills
  • Familiarity with veterinary practice management systems and basic PC hardware/software troubleshooting
  • Ability to clearly and persuasively communicate in both positive and challenging situations; actively listens and provides clarification
  • Written Communication: Writes clearly and informatively; able to interpret written information effectively.
  • Problem Solving: Identifies and resolves issues promptly using sound judgment
  • Dependability: Follows instructions, responds to management direction, and takes responsibility for actions.
  • Planning and Organizing: Prioritizes and plans work efficiently; sets realistic goals and objectives
  • Ethics: Demonstrates integrity, respect, and teamwork
  • Adaptability: Adjusts to changes in the work environment
  • Mental Toughness: Maintains composure in difficult situations

Connectivity Team Only: working knowledge of Veterinary PIMS, PC hardware/software troubleshooting for basic support

At Aldevron, we shape the future of medicine by advancing science in meaningful ways. Our team of dedicated, forward-thinking associates shares this goal by combining best-in-class products and service with the ideal operating environment to lay the groundwork for vital new discoveries worldwide. We believe people are our most valuable asset.

Aldevron is one of 10 Life Sciences companies of Danaher. Together, we accelerate the discovery, development, and delivery of solutions that safeguard and improve human health.

This position is part of the European Sales organization and will be based in Germany but is fully remote. You will be part of the EMEA Sales Team reporting to the Director of Sales, EMEA. As DACH region is a key growth market for Aldevron in Europe, you will be responsible for achieving orders and performance targets by developing new business opportunities, managing complex sales cycles and large (multi-million dollar, multi-year) deals, and building strong executive-level client relationships.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Goal Achievement and Performance Excellence: Consistently meet or exceed assigned orders goals, pipeline metrics, and other key performance indicators (KPIs) by maintaining high standards of client satisfaction and commercial excellence. This includes daily management of sales pipeline data in the CRM system, providing accurate and up-to-date forecasts, and exemplifying best practices in Value Selling and Funnel Management (including particularly CRM rigor).
  • Business Development and Market Share Gain: Identify and develop new business opportunities aligned with the company’s long-term objectives, including gaining market share, launching new products and services, and diversifying Aldevron’s business within existing accounts. Leverage the complete Aldevron portfolio and Danaher connections to further penetrate existing accounts, and proactively identify and engage Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) to drive growth.
  • Complex Sales Cycle Leadership: Manage the entire sales cycle from prospecting to close, using a consultative selling approach to negotiate and close complex opportunities. Lead cross-functional teams, both internally and externally, to tailor solutions for clients, ensuring successful closure of deals. Coach and mentor team members in best practices for funnel management, prospecting, value selling and CRM discipline.
  • Executive Relationship Management: Cultivate and sustain strong, trust-based relationships with key decision-makers and senior or executive leadership to influence buying decisions and foster long-term client loyalty. Serve as a trusted advisor, ensuring Aldevron’s value proposition is clearly communicated and aligned with client needs, and maintain a high level of engagement with stakeholders throughout the sales process.
  • Peer Leadership and Continuous Improvement: Champion a culture of continuous improvement by leading, facilitating, and participating in relevant workshops and leveraging Danaher Business System (DBS) tools. Lead by example in sharing best practices, and mentor peers to help shape team culture, performance standards, and overall organizational excellence.

The essential requirements of the job include:

  • Sales Experience: 7+ years in a client-facing sales role in the life sciences industry, with preferred experience in the biopharma industry selling into the cell and gene therapy client segments, with proven track record of being a top performer. Proven end-to-end management of high-value deals ($1M+)
  • Technical Expertise: Bachelor’s degree in a relevant scientific field. Deep technical knowledge of molecular and cell biology, with the ability to clearly articulate complex biotherapeutic workflows such as nucleic acids, gene editing, DNA plasmids, mRNA therapeutics, viral vector technologies, and ex-vivo cell therapy.
  • CDMO/CMO Sales Background: Demonstrated success in sales roles with Contract Development and/or Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CDMO/CMO) supporting Cell and Gene Therapies, or equivalent experience.
  • Peer Leadership: Proven ability to lead and align cross-functional teams without formal authority, driving collaboration to deliver results for clients and the business.
  • Ability to travel up to 50% in DACH-region.

It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:

  • MS or PhD in a scientific discipline.
  • Quantitative demonstration of consistent territory growth.
  • Continuous improvement methodologies

At Aldevron, we believe in designing a better, more sustainable workforce. We recognize the benefits of flexible, remote working arrangements for eligible roles and are committed to providing enriching careers, no matter the work arrangement. This position is eligible for a remote work arrangement in which you can work remotely from your home. Additional information about this remote work arrangement will be provided by your interview team. Explore the flexibility and challenge that working for Aldevron can provide.

raw.description:
We're Karat, the world's largest interviewing company.

Karat is transforming organizations around the world. We provide a powerful system for technical leaders at companies like PayPal, Atlassian, and Citi who want to take control of how they hire top engineers, elevate their teams and contractors, and stay ahead. At the core of Karat’s system are live, expert-led interviews, analytics designed to give leaders maximum visibility, and the most robust interview performance dataset in the world.

Come join our Professional Services team

Our Professional Services team sits at the center of Karat's largest and most strategic client relationships, turning signed contracts into successful, expanding partnerships through onboarding, delivery, and the ongoing work of proving Karat's value at scale.

What you will do

As a Senior Delivery Partner at Karat, you own the client relationship and delivery strategy for one or more of Karat's most strategic accounts, from onboarding through ramp and expansion. This is an individual contributor role: you lead through credibility and clarity, not formal authority, working alongside a Client Partner, Solutions Engineer, and Project Manager who round out the account pod.

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to client stakeholders through VP and C-level, building relationships where clients bring you their hardest hiring and talent problems.
  • Own the strategic narrative for your account, translating a multi-year transformation into a story that keeps executive stakeholders aligned and moving.
  • Represent Karat with the rigor and polish clients expect from a leading consulting or technology partner.
  • Define the engagement strategy and roadmap, then own execution end-to-end, from statement of work through go-live and steady state, including the change management work (communications, stakeholder alignment, training, resistance management, adoption measurement) that makes it stick.
  • Catch account risk early and give the Client Partner and Karat executives consistent, honest visibility into usage, adoption, satisfaction, and where things stand.
  • Own relationship mapping across your account(s), partnering with the Solutions Engineer and Project Manager, and set the standard for how the pod shows up to the client: one voice, one plan, no surprises.
  • Loop in internal specialists (workforce transformation, content, product, data science) as needed, folding their input into one coherent client narrative.
  • Surface expansion opportunities (new teams, interview types, geographies) to the Client Partner to enable pricing, contracting, and the commercial motion.
  • Translate what you learn at the account into feedback and playbooks that raise the bar for how Karat delivers to its largest clients.

The experience you will bring

  • 8+ years in a client-facing delivery, engagement management, or consulting role, including experience at a consulting firm (for example, McKinsey, Bain, BCG, Deloitte, or Accenture) or in enterprise professional services or customer success at a technology company
  • A track record owning complex, high-stakes client relationships with Fortune 500 or comparable enterprise accounts, from kickoff through steady state and renewal
  • Experience leading cross-functional pods through influence rather than formal authority, earning trust with technical and operational peers who don't report to you
  • Comfort operating with executive stakeholders; you hold your own and earn trust with a client's VP or C-suite
  • Strong commercial instincts; you spot and shape expansion opportunities in partnership with a commercial or account-management counterpart
  • Structured problem-solving under ambiguity; you build the plan rather than wait for one
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; you synthesize broad swaths of input, context, and data into a clear narrative for clients and executives

About the Company

Our client is a U.S.-based performance marketing agency specializing in helping high-growth brands scale through data-driven digital advertising, creative strategy, and emerging commerce channels.

The company works with ambitious eCommerce and direct-to-consumer brands, combining performance media, creative experimentation, analytics, and technology to drive measurable growth. With a strong culture of innovation, testing, and continuous optimization, the team operates at the forefront of rapidly evolving platforms such as TikTok and social commerce.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior TikTok Shop Media Buying Specialist to lead performance and social commerce strategies for high-growth eCommerce brands.

This is a highly specialized role dedicated to the TikTok ecosystem, with a strong focus on maximizing Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) through Video Shopping Ads, Product Shopping Ads, Live Shopping Ads, affiliate content, and TikTok Shop's native commerce tools.

The ideal candidate combines advanced paid media expertise with a deep understanding of how consumers discover and purchase products through TikTok. You should be comfortable managing significant advertising budgets, analyzing performance data, identifying winning creative quickly, and making real-time optimization decisions.

Why This Opportunity?

This role offers the opportunity to work at the intersection of performance marketing, social commerce, creative experimentation, and emerging technology.

You will have direct exposure to high-growth eCommerce brands and significant advertising budgets while helping shape TikTok Shop strategies in a fast-moving environment where creative thinking, analytical decision-making, and speed to market are critical.

What You’ll Do

TikTok Shop Media Buying

  • Build, launch, manage, and optimize Video Shopping Ads (VSA) and Product Shopping Ads (PSA) within TikTok Ads Manager.

  • Develop paid media strategies designed to increase TikTok Shop GMV while maintaining brand-specific profitability targets.

  • Continuously optimize campaign structures, bidding strategies, audiences, budgets, and creative performance.

Livestream & Social Commerce Strategy

  • Manage real-time bidding and traffic orchestration for Live Shopping Ads (LSA) during key brand events.

  • Monitor live campaign performance and make rapid adjustments based on traffic, conversion, inventory, and promotional activity.

  • Identify opportunities to improve the relationship between paid media and organic TikTok Shop activity.

Affiliate & Creator Scaling

  • Identify high-performing affiliate content through the TikTok Shop Affiliate Center.

  • Scale winning affiliate content using Spark Ads and GMV Max.

  • Analyze affiliate performance to determine which creators and assets should receive additional paid amplification.

TikTok Shop Management

  • Monitor TikTok Shop Seller Center performance and overall account health.

  • Ensure advertising strategies remain aligned with inventory availability, promotions, product performance, and shop activity.

  • Identify potential operational or performance issues that could impact campaign results.

Creative Testing & Optimization

  • Collaborate closely with creative teams to rapidly test hooks, concepts, transitions, formats, and TikTok-native trends.

  • Use performance data and AI-driven insights to guide creative iteration.

  • Identify winning assets quickly and translate performance learnings into actionable creative recommendations.

  • Maintain a strong understanding of TikTok-native content and what drives users from discovery to purchase.

Analytics & Reporting

  • Analyze and report on ROAS, CAC, settled GMV, affiliate performance, and creative effectiveness.

  • Translate TikTok's attribution and commerce data into clear, actionable recommendations.

  • Communicate campaign performance and strategic recommendations effectively to clients and internal stakeholders.

  • Use data to identify opportunities for additional growth and improved efficiency.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in Paid Social Media Buying.

  • At least 1 year of specialized hands-on experience within the TikTok Shop ecosystem.

  • Proven experience managing $100K+ in monthly advertising spend, preferably for direct-to-consumer (DTC) brands.

  • Advanced hands-on experience with:

    • TikTok Ads Manager

    • TikTok Shop Seller Center

    • TikTok Shop Affiliate Center

  • Strong understanding of Video Shopping Ads, Product Shopping Ads, Live Shopping Ads, Spark Ads, and GMV Max.

  • Demonstrated ability to analyze and optimize campaigns based on GMV, ROAS, CAC, and other performance metrics.

  • Strong Google Sheets skills, including data analysis and modeling.

  • Experience working with TikTok Creative Center.

  • Strong understanding of performance creative and the ability to identify effective hooks, formats, and TikTok-native creative trends.

  • Excellent client-facing communication and presentation skills.

  • Full professional proficiency in written and spoken English.

  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, performance-driven remote environment.

  • Ability to work PST or EST hours and participate in daily stand-ups and real-time campaign adjustments.

  • High-speed internet connection and a dedicated professional remote workspace.

Preferred Qualifications

  • TikTok Academy certifications in Media Buying and/or TikTok Shop.

  • Experience with Looker Studio.

  • Familiarity with AI-powered creative and video iteration tools such as CapCut, Symphony, or generative AI tools.

  • Experience with additional paid media platforms such as Meta Ads Manager, Pinterest Ads, or Amazon Marketing Services (AMS).

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Data Science, Economics, or a related field.

How Success Is Measured

Success in this role will be evaluated based on:

  • Total Shop GMV: Consistent month-over-month growth in settled TikTok Shop revenue.

  • Shop ROAS: Maintaining advertising efficiency above brand-specific profitability thresholds.

  • Affiliate Synergy: Increasing the percentage of revenue generated through successfully amplified affiliate content.

  • Creative Win Rate: Effectively identifying winning creative assets within the first 48–72 hours of testing.

  • Ability to translate performance data into actionable campaign and creative decisions.

  • Speed and effectiveness in adapting strategies as TikTok Shop trends, products, and campaign performance evolve.

Why Join Us

  • Work directly with high-growth eCommerce and DTC brands.

  • Manage meaningful advertising budgets and sophisticated TikTok Shop campaigns.

  • Develop expertise in one of the fastest-evolving areas of digital commerce.

  • Collaborate with experienced performance marketing, creative, and strategy professionals.

  • Work in an environment that values experimentation, data-driven decision-making, innovation, and speed.

  • Build strategies that directly influence revenue and measurable business growth.

Important Notes

  • This role is specifically focused on TikTok Shop and social commerce. Candidates should have direct, hands-on TikTok Shop experience rather than only general paid social experience.

  • Candidates must be comfortable working with significant advertising budgets and making performance-driven optimization decisions.

  • Full professional English proficiency is required due to the client-facing nature of the position.

  • Candidates must be available to work PST or EST hours.

  • This is a remote/telecommute position.

Location: This position may be performed remotely, but requires the flexibility and willingness to travel as needed.

The Opportunity

Praxis is expanding the engineering team behind the data foundation that powers our growing commercial organization. As a Senior Snowflake Platform Engineer, you will own the reliability, governance, security, and cost transparency of our Snowflake environment as the scale and importance of our data operations grow.

You will take a hands-on approach to platform engineering—solving production issues at their root, automating recurring work, strengthening controls, and building the monitoring and recovery capabilities that make the platform easier for others to operate. You will work closely with Data Engineering, Security, Identity, AWS, and commercial technology partners to ensure critical data is available, appropriately protected, and ready when the business needs it.

You will measure success by more than keeping Snowflake running. You will leave behind a platform that is increasingly reliable, observable, automated, cost-transparent, and supportable by the broader team—giving our engineers more capacity to build capabilities that ultimately support our mission for patients.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Own Snowflake platform operations and health, including databases, schemas, warehouses, roles, tasks, procedures, and related services across development, test, and production environments. Maintain clear ownership and an accurate inventory of critical platform assets.
  • Strengthen platform security and governance by designing and automating role-based access, object ownership, grants, and access lifecycle controls. Partner with Identity and Security teams to maintain least-privilege access, effective identity integration, and timely access reviews and removal.
  • Drive platform reliability and proactively resolve issues across workloads, ingestion, dependencies, authentication, and data freshness. Perform root-cause analysis, implement durable solutions, and establish monitoring and alerts that identify issues before they affect users.
  • Build resilient and repeatable production support practices through actionable monitoring, runbooks, escalation paths, recovery procedures, and rollback capabilities. Participate in incident response, validate recovery approaches, and cross-train colleagues to eliminate single points of dependency.
  • Manage and optimize Snowflake consumption by establishing visibility into usage by workload and owner, identifying meaningful consumption trends, developing forecasts and thresholds, and optimizing warehouse configuration and high-cost workloads without compromising reliability or performance.
  • Automate and strengthen platform change management using version control, testing, peer review, automation, and controlled promotion across environments. Coordinate release readiness and regression testing across Snowflake, connected applications, vendor integrations, and AWS dependencies.
  • Create transparency and continuously improve the platform by reporting on reliability, access hygiene, consumption, and outstanding risks. Simplify unnecessary complexity, build reusable automation, maintain meaningful documentation, and thoughtfully apply AI to accelerate engineering while protecting data and production quality.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of relevant experience across data platforms, cloud engineering, or data engineering—or equivalent demonstrated technical depth—with substantial hands-on experience operating Snowflake in production.
  • Strong SQL and Python skills, including experience automating operational work and investigating complex production failures.
  • Deep practical knowledge of Snowflake security and operations, including roles, grants, object ownership, warehouses, tasks, stored procedures, and operational telemetry.
  • Experience managing enterprise identities, service credentials, least-privilege access, and access lifecycle controls in partnership with Identity and Security teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to understand platform consumption, optimize workloads, and make thoughtful tradeoffs among cost, performance, and reliability.
  • Experience with Git-based development, peer review, automated testing, controlled releases, monitoring, incident response, and documented recovery procedures.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant technical field or equivalent practical experience.
  • The physical and mental requirements of our roles include but are not limited to regular use of a computer, devices or other office equipment, clear communication, and occasional movement. You'll need comfort with screen work, basic hand coordination, and focus. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions.
Annualized Base Salary
$140,000—$160,000 USD

Compensation & BenefitsAt Praxis, we believe that taking care of our people (and their people) is important, so we provide a world class benefits package to help you thrive.  This includes 99% of the premium paid for medical, dental and vision plans. We also provide company-paid life insurance, AD&D, disability benefits, and voluntary plans to personalize your coverage. Thinking about the future?  We match dollar-for-dollar up to 6% on eligible 401(k) contributions and sweeten the deal with long-term stock incentives and ESPP.  We provide a discretionary quarterly bonus, an extremely flexible wellness benefit, generous PTO, paid holidays and company-wide shutdowns.  Not to mention, you'll also be joining a phenomenal crew of colleagues who are smart, engaged and inspiring.  We aim high, collaborate hard, and produce results.  Let’s achieve the impossible together!

Company Overview

Praxis Precision Medicines is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company translating genetic insights into the development of therapies for central nervous system disorders characterized by neuronal imbalance. At Praxis we share a common vision of reshaping the human condition into a more freeing and fulfilled existence by developing high impact medicines for patients and families affected by and living with complex brain disorders. Our core Values of Trust, Ownership, Curiosity and Results are foundational to every aspect of our business and are exemplified by each and every one of our team members.

Diversity, Equity & Inclusion
Guided by our core values, at Praxis Precision Medicines, Inc. we continue to DARE FOR MORE® to advance, promote, and champion diversity, equity, and inclusion by encouraging individuals to bring their authentic selves and perspectives to work each day. We are an equal opportunity employer and committed to providing opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, religious creed, color, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, genetics, military service and veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

These postings seek financial information in connection with fraudulent opportunities for employment. raw.description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring a Regional HR Manager for EMEA to join our People team at Canonical.

With 1,200+ colleagues across 75​ ​countries, we require a People function that thinks and acts globally.​ We're looking for a regional lead that will report into our Global Head of HR who can help build our company as we go through continued growth plans. It's an exciting time to join with the opportunity to help shape and create an HR function for the future. You will lead the EMEA team of HR professionals to provide precise, compliant and scalable HR operations to the business, advise and execute on HR issues across the whole employee life-cycle, and partner with senior leadership in your region. You will have an analytical approach, a keen eye for detail and the ability to interpret data trends and themes.

The role entails the individual to:

  • Lead and scale Canonical’s regional HR team
  • Deliver precise and compliant HR operations in a timely manner and with the highest degree of accuracy
  • Interact closely with the broader People team to create tight-knit processes across all regions
  • Be accountable for HR processes such as talent development, succession planning, performance assessments, onboarding, culture and engagement initiatives that drive high performing teams
  • Work with senior managers across the business on performance management, organizational design, employee engagement, rewards- and workforce planning
  • Own as well as coach and advise people managers on the full spectrum of employee relations issues, across multiple countries
  • Partner with people managers to support the delivery of appropriate training and development programs
  • Establish a trusted partnership with the business in your region
  • Drive diversity, equity, and inclusion initiatives
  • Design new policies and deliver on business-critical HR related projects globally
  • Present at Canonical events to articulate Canonical’s HR practices

What we are looking for in you

  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • HR experience leading initiatives across regions within a technology business
  • People management experience
  • Experience in business partnering with senior stakeholders
  • A good balance between leading and executing, in this role you will need to be hands-on involved in the daily HR routines too
  • Experience in working in a remote first organization
  • Able to leverage data to make informed decisions
  • Knowledge and practical implementation of HR practices and employment law across EMEA
  • Experience in handling and overseeing complex ER matters across multiple jurisdictions
  • Fluent in business English (written and spoken)
  • Self motivated, organized, accurate, confident, authentic, results-orientated, open-minded, enthusiastic and energetic
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events

Nice-to-have skills

  • Experience with immigration policies and mobility processes
  • Professional HR qualification (CIPD/SHRM or other)
  • Facilitation skills

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

raw.title: AI/ML Engineering Intern
raw.excerpt: Location: Remote (United States) Work Model: Remote Industry: AI recruiting and talent marketplace (B2B SaaS) Compensation: $35–$50 per hour About the CompanyTalentPluto is a Y Combinator-backed startup building the hiring stack for high-growth companies.
raw.description:
Location: Remote (United States)

Work Model: Remote

Industry: AI recruiting and talent marketplace (B2B SaaS)

Compensation: $35–$50 per hour

About the Company

TalentPluto is a Y Combinator-backed startup building the hiring stack for high-growth companies. We run two connected products: a talent network that places engineering, go-to-market, and operations people into fast-moving startups, and an AI recruiting tool that lets a hiring team run candidate search, tiered enrichment, rubric-based scoring, and outbound campaigns directly from their assistant. We work with dozens of venture-backed startups across AI, developer tools, fintech, and healthcare. The team is small and founder-led, and interns work on live problems rather than practice ones.

The Opportunity

This is an applied AI internship inside a product where the model output is the product. We use LLMs to read unstructured professional histories, extract structure from them, score candidates against a role, and rank what a recruiter sees first. Every one of those steps can be confidently wrong, so the interesting work is as much about evaluating quality as it is about building the pipeline.

You will work on real LLM workflows against messy data at volume: designing prompts and extraction logic, building the evaluations that tell you whether a change actually helped, and improving ranking and retrieval where the current answer is not good enough. This is applied rather than research work, and you will be able to see the effect of what you build on what real users get.

Responsibilities

  • Build and improve LLM workflows for extraction, scoring, and ranking against real product data.
  • Design evaluations that measure output quality, and use them to judge whether a change is an improvement.
  • Work with messy, high-volume unstructured data and turn it into reliable structure.
  • Improve retrieval and ranking so the most relevant results surface first.
  • Investigate incorrect or low-quality output and trace it back to its cause.

Requirements

  • Strong programming fundamentals in Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, or a similar language.
  • Interest in applied AI, machine learning, LLMs, ranking, retrieval, or data systems.
  • Comfort working with messy data and evaluating output quality.
  • Has built AI/ML, data, class, research, or side projects.
  • Strong problem-solving ability and a willingness to learn quickly.
  • Clear communicator who can work independently in a remote environment.

Westland Insurance Group is growing and has an exciting opportunity for an Insurance Advisor to work within MyGroup in Ontario. This is a fully remote position. Do you love to talk about insurance and provide exceptional client service? If so, you will love working for Westland! We are looking for a career minded individual who is focused on growing their insurance industry knowledge and experience.

Expected Compensation: The expected hiring range for this role is $51,000 - $54,000 based on a 35-hour work week. Actual offered salary will depend on the successful candidate’s qualifications and experience, as well as market conditions for the role, and internal equity.

Reason for Vacancy: This posting is to fill a current vacancy on our team.

We are open to accepting applicants from other provinces with a valid RIBO license and willingness to work in the Eastern Time Zone.

Discover what’s possible, with Westland.

The Westland story is all about growth, and that means plenty of possibilities for everyone on our team. Every day, Westland proves that building a great business means taking care of communities, clients, and each other with equal commitment. As we continue to open new doors, we're inviting amazing people like you to join us.

As an Insurance Advisor, you promote and educate clients on insurance products, take ownership of client relationships, and help us grow our presence and profile in the local community. You’ll also manage more complex insurance cases and help team members reach their potential.

Interested in learning more?

Why you'll love Westland:

  • An open, flexible and welcoming workplace
  • Plenty of opportunities to grow and learn
  • Autonomy to drive your own success
  • Be part of our inclusive culture, alongside an extraordinarily talented community of people with a wide variety of backgrounds
  • A total rewards program that takes care of your financial, physical, and mental health
  • Flexible paid Values Days to celebrate days important to you
  • Paid Volunteer Days for employees as part of Amplifying Communities, a program to support causes that matter most to our employees and clients

Why we’ll love you:

  • Minimum 3 years RIBO license
  • Strong knowledge of personal lines insurance products and underwriting principles
  • Effective team collaborator who supports peers and contributes to team success
  • Building authentic client relationships comes naturally to you
  • Master time manager who can prioritize workload while demonstrating confidentiality and discretion
  • Self-starter mentality with the ability to meet production targets while working independently
  • Experience using insurer portals and related systems
  • At least 3 years of industry experience

Once here, you'll:

  • Work with clients to uncover their insurance needs, identify opportunities, and provide recommendations based on your knowledge of coverage and underwriting principles
  • Practice excellent customer service and prioritize client relationship management by actively listening to queries and concerns
  • Develop new business through cross-selling, upselling, referrals, and securing ex-dates
  • Review renewals on a timely basis while maintaining strong retention levels
  • Process policy changes and endorsements accurately through various company portals
  • Support clients through the claims process while communicating accurate information to claims teams
  • Collaborate with a supportive team to reach organizational goals

As part of our commitment to transparency, we want to let you know that while our recruitment system includes AI capabilities, these are never used to screen, evaluate, or select candidates. The only AI functionality that Westland uses is for transcribing notes during candidate calls, and this occurs with your consent. These tools aren't used to make any hiring decisions throughout our recruitment process.

Want to get to know each other better? Send your resume our way.

You belong here We strive to be much more than a great place to work. Here, you join a collective of incredibly vibrant, purpose driven, and open-minded people. Every day, Westland proves that building a great business means taking care of communities, clients, and each other with equal commitment. You will be supported and respected for who you are and for the voice you add to the conversation.

At Westland, you will feel the power of community. Westland Insurance Ltd. is an inclusive organization that values diversity in its workforce. We listen, champion equity and diversity, and create safe welcoming spaces where everyone has a voice and is free to be themselves. Location: Remote (United States)

Work Model: Remote

Industry: AI recruiting and talent marketplace (B2B SaaS)

Compensation: $35–$50 per hour

About the Company

TalentPluto is a Y Combinator-backed startup building the hiring stack for high-growth companies. We run two connected products: a talent network that places engineering, go-to-market, and operations people into fast-moving startups, and an AI recruiting tool that lets a hiring team run candidate search, tiered enrichment, rubric-based scoring, and outbound campaigns directly from their assistant. We work with dozens of venture-backed startups across AI, developer tools, fintech, and healthcare. The team is small and founder-led, and interns work on live problems rather than practice ones.

The Opportunity

This is an applied AI internship inside a product where the model output is the product. We use LLMs to read unstructured professional histories, extract structure from them, score candidates against a role, and rank what a recruiter sees first. Every one of those steps can be confidently wrong, so the interesting work is as much about evaluating quality as it is about building the pipeline.

You will work on real LLM workflows against messy data at volume: designing prompts and extraction logic, building the evaluations that tell you whether a change actually helped, and improving ranking and retrieval where the current answer is not good enough. This is applied rather than research work, and you will be able to see the effect of what you build on what real users get.

Responsibilities

  • Build and improve LLM workflows for extraction, scoring, and ranking against real product data.
  • Design evaluations that measure output quality, and use them to judge whether a change is an improvement.
  • Work with messy, high-volume unstructured data and turn it into reliable structure.
  • Improve retrieval and ranking so the most relevant results surface first.
  • Investigate incorrect or low-quality output and trace it back to its cause.

Requirements

  • Strong programming fundamentals in Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, or a similar language.
  • Interest in applied AI, machine learning, LLMs, ranking, retrieval, or data systems.
  • Comfort working with messy data and evaluating output quality.
  • Has built AI/ML, data, class, research, or side projects.
  • Strong problem-solving ability and a willingness to learn quickly.
  • Clear communicator who can work independently in a remote environment.

Job Description:

The Sr. Observability Engineer II is a specialized engineering role serving as the subject matter expert for the Dynatrace observability platform. The primary purpose of this role is to mature the firm’s proactive monitoring capabilities by focusing on signal quality engineering and operational noise reduction. This position functions as a key technical liaison between Hosting Operations, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), and other engineering teams to ensure the stability and reliability of our client-facing healthcare SaaS environment.
  • Engineer and maintain the Dynatrace multi-tenant environment configuration, including management zones, alerting profiles, metric and custom events, tagging strategies, and access boundaries.
  • Own the end-to-end alert lifecycle, defining ownership, naming standards, severity mapping, alert disposition taxonomies, and production-readiness criteria.
  • Systematically eliminate alert fatigue across top problem patterns utilizing advanced tuning, thresholds, correlation, suppression, and alert retirement, while maintaining robust coverage for real, client-impacting issues.
  • Design and implement synthetic monitors and business-centric service-health models for critical client journeys and access paths, ensuring degradation is detected in service and business terms rather than raw infrastructure metrics.
  • Author and standardize Dynatrace Query Language (DQL) queries, notebooks, and dashboards for operations, leadership, and reliability reporting, establishing best-practice development standards for the team.
  • Collaborate with tools administrators to manage observability configurations using configuration-as-code practices, ensuring monitoring setups are versioned, peer-reviewed, and reproducible.
  • Partner with Tools, Automation and SRE teams to enhance alert-to-ticket enrichment (such as Salesforce ITSM integrations) with context and probable cause, minimizing triage times and enabling automated remediation.
  • Partner with SQL, platform, OS, and API specialists to resolve monitoring blind spots, ensure domain-specific alerts are meaningful, and verify that alerts are backed by robust runbooks.
  • Support service-level (P1–P4) measurements by establishing reporting baselines for corporate accountability, ensuring noise-reduction changes are paired with strict operational guardrails.
  • Maintain comprehensive reference materials, standard operating procedures, and observability standards documentation in Confluence to support continuous team enablement and operational onboarding.
  • Perform other duties that support the overall objective of the position.

Education Required:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field.
  • Or, any combination of education and experience which would provide the required qualifications for the position.

Experience Required:

  • 7+ years of experience in observability, application performance monitoring (APM), monitoring engineering, site reliability engineering (SRE), or a closely related technology infrastructure field.
  • Demonstrable hands-on expertise with the Dynatrace platform, including Davis AI, DQL, dashboards, notebooks, management zones, alerting profiles, metric/custom events, and synthetic monitors.
  • Proven track record of designing, configuring, and tuning alerting systems at enterprise scale to successfully reduce noise while maintaining robust detection capabilities.
  • Experience integrating monitoring systems with enterprise ITSM/ticketing systems (such as Salesforce) for automated ticket routing and enrichment.
  • Experience working within highly regulated hosting environments (e.g., healthcare, HIPAA/HITRUST, SOC 2, or ISO 27001).

License/Certification Required:

  • Dynatrace certification (or commitment to obtain certification within 1 year of hire).

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

  • Knowledge of: Strong working knowledge of AWS infrastructure, Windows and Linux operating systems, and SQL Server database concepts. Advanced understanding of cloud-native observability frameworks, APM tools (specifically Dynatrace), and alert lifecycle management. Strong command of cloud computing (AWS), systems integration, database operations, and scripting (e.g., Python or PowerShell) to support automation.
  • Skill in: Excellent problem-solving capabilities. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Highly organized, detail-oriented, and self-driven, with a strong ownership mindset toward maintaining signal quality, reducing operational toil, and defending client service-level agreements.
  • Ability to: Proven ability to translate complex technical infrastructure metrics into direct service and business impacts. Ability to collaborate effectively across operations command analysts, SRE partners, database specialists, and leadership.

26WD100466, AI Builder, Principal Product Manager

Position Overview

This is a role for a product leader who wants to fundamentally change how the platform works, and can prove it, not just pitch it. You will join a small, AI-native disrupt squad within Autodesk’s Platform Services & Emerging Technologies (PSET) organization, accountable for redefining how the platform is experienced, accessed, and built upon.

You won’t be handed a roadmap. You will identify high-leverage opportunities, define what should exist, and demonstrate a dramatically better way through working proofs, using AI, real systems, and rapid experimentation.

Your role is not to write requirements and hand them off. On this team, product thinking, experience design, and engineering are rethinking how to work as an AI native delivery team. As the product-minded AI Builder, you bring deep product thinking into the what and the why, and you stay close enough to the how that your direction is grounded in something real. In practice, that means building AI-assisted prototypes, shaping demos, and working directly with data yourself.

Your focus is not on managing backlogs or operating production systems. You are accountable for turning friction into opportunity and delivering working proofs that make a new approach credible and hard to dismiss.

Responsibilities

  • Find the seams, bottlenecks, and handoffs that make the platform harder to use than it should be, and identify the few where a different approach creates outsized value for customers and the business

  • Define what should exist, framing fuzzy, multi-system problems into a clear direction the team can build against

  • Decide what to challenge: actively question whether existing capabilities should be replaced, simplified, or significantly improved, and use experimentation to settle it on evidence rather than opinion

  • Prove it: partner with experience designers and developers, and get hands-on yourself with AI tools, prompts, and data, to build working proofs that show something actually works, not just that it could

  • Package the results as clear “before vs after” proof points that make friction visible and the better approach undeniable, creating pull for change across teams

  • Translate what the proofs reveal into direction: what the platform should become next, and a viable path to get there

Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years driving product direction in complex, technical environments, with deep customer and business understanding and a strong track record of using experimentation to discover, validate, and evolve solutions

  • Acts with agency in ambiguous spaces, setting direction and making progress before anyone hands them a plan

  • Strong product judgment: consistently prioritizes what creates disproportionate value across systems, not just within a single feature or area

  • Hands-on experience building AI-assisted prototypes or demos (prompt design, agentic workflows, tool integrations) to validate direction

  • Proven ability to operate across product, engineering, and experience, shaping solutions end-to-end rather than handing off between functions

  • Turns high-leverage problems and insight into tangible, working outcomes, whether prototypes or proofs, not just requirements, decks, or roadmaps

  • Strong ability to synthesize user needs, business context, and technical constraints into clear, defensible direction

  • Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders and drive alignment across teams without relying on formal authority

  • High learning velocity and comfort operating in ambiguous, fast-evolving problem spaces

Preferred Qualifications

  • Shipped 0→1 products or features, ideally in workflow-heavy enterprise products or greenfield SaaS

  • Ability to structure product intent as an interface for agentic work, validated through hypothesis-driven, metrics-based iteration.

  • Experience comparing multiple solution approaches and deciding based on outcomes, not opinions

  • Familiarity with complex multi-system environments and navigate platform level changes required to achieve business outcomes

26WD100466, AI Builder, chef de produit principal

Aperçu du Poste

Ce poste s'adresse à un responsable produit désireux de transformer en profondeur le fonctionnement de la plateforme, et capable de le prouver concrètement, et non pas seulement de le présenter en théorie. Vous rejoindrez une petite équipe innovante, spécialisée dans l’IA, au sein de l’organisation Platform Services & Emerging Technologies (PSET) d’Autodesk, chargée de redéfinir l’expérience utilisateur, l’accès et les possibilités d’extension de la plateforme.

On ne vous remettra pas de feuille de route toute faite. Vous identifierez les opportunités à fort impact, définirez ce qui devrait exister et démontrerez une approche nettement plus efficace grâce à des preuves de concept fonctionnelles, en utilisant l’IA, des systèmes réels et une expérimentation rapide.

Votre rôle ne consiste pas à rédiger des cahiers des charges pour les transmettre ensuite. Au sein de cette équipe, la réflexion produit, la conception d’expérience utilisateur et l’ingénierie repensent la manière de travailler en tant qu’équipe de développement native en IA. En tant que développeur IA axé sur le produit, vous apportez une réflexion produit approfondie sur le « quoi » et le « pourquoi », tout en restant suffisamment proche du « comment » pour que votre orientation repose sur des bases concrètes. Concrètement, cela implique de créer des prototypes assistés par l’IA, de mettre au point des démonstrations et de travailler vous-même directement avec les données.

Votre priorité n’est pas de gérer les carnets de commandes ni d’exploiter les systèmes de production. Vous êtes chargé(e) de transformer les frictions en opportunités et de fournir des preuves de concept fonctionnelles qui rendent une nouvelle approche crédible et difficile à rejeter.

Responsabilités

  • Identifier les failles, les goulots d’étranglement et les transferts de tâches qui rendent la plateforme plus difficile à utiliser qu’elle ne devrait l’être, et repérer les rares cas où une approche différente crée une valeur exceptionnelle pour les clients et l’entreprise

  • Définir ce qui devrait exister, en transformant des problèmes flous et impliquant plusieurs systèmes en une orientation claire sur laquelle l’équipe peut s’appuyer pour développer des solutions

  • Décider ce qu’il faut remettre en question : s’interroger activement sur la nécessité de remplacer, simplifier ou améliorer significativement les capacités existantes, et recourir à l’expérimentation pour trancher sur la base de preuves plutôt que d’opinions

  • Le prouver : collaborer avec des concepteurs d’expérience utilisateur et des développeurs, et mettre vous-même la main à la pâte avec des outils d’IA, des invites et des données, afin de construire des preuves de concept fonctionnelles qui démontrent qu’une solution fonctionne réellement, et pas seulement qu’elle pourrait fonctionner

  • Présenter les résultats sous forme de preuves claires « avant/après » qui rendent les frictions visibles et l’approche la plus efficace indéniable, créant ainsi une dynamique de changement au sein des équipes

  • Traduire ce que les preuves révèlent en une orientation : ce que la plateforme devrait devenir à l’avenir, et une voie viable pour y parvenir

Qualifications Minimales

  • Au moins 8 ans d’expérience dans la définition de l’orientation produit au sein d’environnements techniques complexes, avec une compréhension approfondie des clients et de l’activité, ainsi qu’une solide expérience dans l’utilisation de l’expérimentation pour découvrir, valider et faire évoluer des solutions

  • Capacité à agir de manière autonome dans des contextes ambigus, en définissant une orientation et en faisant avancer les choses avant même qu’un plan ne lui soit fourni

  • Excellent jugement en matière de produit : hiérarchise systématiquement ce qui crée une valeur disproportionnée à l’échelle des systèmes, et non pas uniquement au sein d’une fonctionnalité ou d’un domaine isolé

  • Expérience pratique dans la création de prototypes ou de démos assistés par l’IA (conception de prompts, workflows autonomes, intégrations d’outils) pour valider l’orientation

  • Capacité avérée à intervenir à la croisée des domaines produit, ingénierie et expérience utilisateur, en façonnant des solutions de bout en bout plutôt qu’en se contentant de transférer les tâches d’une fonction à l’autre

  • Transforme les problèmes à fort impact et les insights en résultats concrets et fonctionnels, qu’il s’agisse de prototypes ou de preuves de concept, et non pas simplement d’exigences, de présentations ou de feuilles de route

  • Grande capacité à synthétiser les besoins des utilisateurs, le contexte métier et les contraintes techniques pour définir une orientation claire et défendable

  • Capacité avérée à influencer les parties prenantes et à favoriser l’alignement entre les équipes sans s’appuyer sur une autorité formelle

  • Grande capacité d’apprentissage et aisance à évoluer dans des contextes problématiques ambigus et en constante évolution

Qualifications Souhaitées

  • Avoir mené à bien le lancement de produits ou de fonctionnalités « 0→1 », idéalement dans le cadre de produits d’entreprise à flux de travail intensif ou de solutions SaaS entièrement nouvelles

  • Capacité à structurer l’intention du produit en tant qu’interface pour un travail autonome, validée par des itérations fondées sur des hypothèses et basées sur des indicateurs

  • Expérience dans la comparaison de plusieurs approches de solution et la prise de décision en fonction des résultats, et non d’opinions

  • Connaissance des environnements multisystèmes complexes et capacité à gérer les changements au niveau de la plateforme nécessaires pour atteindre les résultats commerciaux

Learn More

About Autodesk

Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.

We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world.

When you’re an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us!

Salary transparency

Salary is one part of Autodesk’s competitive compensation package. For Canada based roles, we expect a starting base salary between $142,000 and $207,900. Offers are based on the candidate’s experience and geographic location, and may exceed this range. In addition to base salaries, our compensation package may include annual cash bonuses, commissions for sales roles, stock grants, and a comprehensive benefits package.

Belonging

raw.description:
Want to show the world how to build AI infrastructure? Want to guide new cloud builders on how to design, build and operate AI cloud networks? Better yet, want to build an AI assistant that does this for you? If you have a network engineering background and you enjoy telling good stories while documenting and demonstrating technology, this is the job for you.

As Hedgehog's first Technical Marketing Engineer, you will play a key role in defining this critical job function at a fast growing open source company leading the AI Network category. In the short term you will:

Explain the Hedgehog product producing 2-3 minute YouTube videos covering a range of topics including:

  • Hedgehog Virtual Private Cloud service
  • Hedgehog Control Plane
  • Hedgehog Data Plane
  • Hedgehog Zero Touch Provisioning
  • Hedgehog Network Observability
  • Hedgehog Network Troubleshooting
  • Hedgehog Software Updates

Demonstrate the Hedgehog product live for prospective customers.

Wear a second hat as a technical writer improving technical documentation from our engineering team. Improvements include tech writing best practices for a quick start guide, tutorials, lab exercises, background information, glossary, and context that frames the software engineering details.

Train a Hedgehog virtual assistant to answer customer questions by feeding your technical documentation and marketing material into Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) for an open source Large Language Model (LLM).

Guide prospective customers through virtual lab exercises so they can evaluate the same product features that you demonstrate in videos and discovery calls.

Assist prospective customers in designing, planning and scoping their AI cloud infrastructure.

Assist prospective customers in documenting their infrastructure as code, implementing Gitops, and integrating Hedgehog into their Gitops process.

Position Hedgehog relative to our partners and competitors.

Handle customer objections and build objection handling playbooks for SDRs using Hubspot.

Write blogs on AI network topics, Hedgehog capabilities, and Hedgehog customer stories.

Train new sellers at Hedgehog and our GTM partners on how to position Hedgehog in AI cloud infrastructure solutions.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's or Graduate's Degree in computer science, data science, electronics, or engineering.

  • Industry experience with cloud networking and/or a strong understanding of cloud networking concepts like VPC, BGP EVPN, VXLAN, NAT, DHCP, ZTP, SDN, RoCEv2, ECN, PFC

  • Strong technical writing skills demonstrated by a reference portfolio

  • Strong oral communication with a gift to simply explain complex technical concepts with stories that non-technical people can easily understand

  • Basic video editing skills

Bonus:

  • Degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field

  • Curious nature and desire to tinker: you want to pull things apart to see how they work

  • Love of new and emerging technologies

  • Ability to distill complicated ideas to just the right number of words

  • Experienced with technical writing using Markdown and Material for MkDocs

  • Experience with AI/ML models

  • Experience with open source software

  • Experience in embedded or network engineering, technical support, product testing, or QA

Hedgehog Benefits

  • World-class team
  • Fun culture
  • Engaging and interesting engineering problems
  • Competitive salary
  • Startup equity
  • Health Insurance (Medical, Dental, Vision)
  • Unlimited time off
  • Work from home (fully remote - we don't care where you are; we care about what you can do)
  • Laptop, IT equipment

About Hedgehog

AI needs a new network. Hedgehog is the AI network. AI developers need new cloud infrastructure with high performance compute that trains and tunes generative AI models quickly and efficiently. They need ultra-low latency for AI inference so users get a human experience. Traditional cloud networks lack the congestion control and adaptive routing required to minimize AI job completion time. AI cloud builders find current reference architectures expensive and difficult to operate because they require specialized network engineers from a very limited number of vendors. Hedgehog delivers a high performance AI network that reduces AI job completion time up to 35% with flow scheduling and buffer management for congestion control and adaptive routing. Our low latency cloud network is multi-tenant for so that many teams can tune models, and many people can use model. A Hedgehog cloud network is easy to operate. If you know how to use AWS, Azure to Google Cloud, you can run a Hedgehog cloud. And you can build a Hedgehog AI cloud at reasonable cost with open source software, white box hardware from a wide selection of vendors, and fully automated operations with your existing team.

POSITION SUMMARY

This position coordinates and facilitates patient billing and collection activities in one or more assigned areas of billing, payment posting, collections, payor claims research, and other accounts receivable work. Works as a member of a team to ensure reimbursement for services in a timely and accurate manner.

CORE FUNCTIONS

1. May be assigned to process payments, adjustments, claims, correspondence, refunds, denials, financial/charity applications, and/or payment plans in an accurate and timely manner, meeting goals in work quality and productivity. Coordinates with other staff members and physician office staff as necessary ensure correct processing.

2. As assigned, reconciles, balances and pursues account balances and payments, and/or denials, working with payor remits, facility contracts, payor customer service, provider representatives, spreadsheets and the company’s collection/self-pay policies to ensure maximum reimbursement.

3. May be assigned to research payments, denials and/or accounts to determine short/over payments, contract discrepancies, incorrect financial classes, internal/external errors. Makes appeals and corrections as necessary.

4. Builds strong working relationships with assigned business units, hospital departments or provider offices. Identifies trends in payment issues and communicates with internal and external customers as appropriate to educate and correct problems. Provides assistance and excellent customer service to these internal clients.

5. Responds to incoming calls and makes outbound calls as required to resolve billing, payment and accounting issues. Provides assistance and excellent customer service to patients, patient families, providers, and other internal and external customers.

6. Works as a member of the patient financial services team to achieve goals in days and dollars of outstanding accounts. Reduces Accounts Receivable balances.

7. Uses systems to document and to provide statistical data, prepare issues list(s) and to communicate with payors accurately.

8. Works independently under general supervision, following defined standards and procedures. Reports to a Supervisor or Manger. Uses critical thinking skills to solve problems and reconcile accounts in a timely manner. External customers include all hospital patients, patient families and all third party payers. Internal customers include facility medical records and patient financial services staff, attorneys, and central services staff members.

High school diploma/GED or equivalent working knowledge.

Requires knowledge of patient financial services, financial, collecting services or insurance industry experience processes normally acquired over one or more years of work experience. Requires the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously with minimal supervision and to work independently. Requires strong interpersonal, oral, and written communication skills to effectively interact with a wide range of audiences.

Strong knowledge in the use of common office software, word processing, spreadsheet, and database software are required.

Work experience with the Company’s systems and processes is preferred. Previous cash collections experience is preferred.

Additional related education and/or experience preferred.

DMI, LLC is seeking a Contact Center Manager to join our staff. Call center managers are in charge of hiring, training, supervising, and motivating the call center's employees. Their responsibility is to ensure that their agents meet the objectives of and offer great customer service.

The duties of a call center manager generally involve a combination of team management, analytics, and human resource tasks. To make sure that customer objectives are accomplished, they create goals for a call center's daily operations and examine call center statistics. Managers must collaborate with call center agents to achieve the major objectives of productivity and efficiency.

The person in this position looks at the big picture to identify potential improvements as they arise as part of effective contact center management. Agent effectiveness is their primary focus, they must have the ability to intuitively assess their team for possible issues before they manifest. Maintaining positive relationships with their agents and enforcing company policies to achieve performance targets is essential for Contact Center Manager’s success.

  • Hire, train, coach, and lead agents in supporting our customers’ requests
  • Develop agents, work with them on a career path to suit their skills, develop a plan with them to get them to where they want to go.
