raw.title: Global Specialist Solution Architect - Lightwell
raw.excerpt: The Red Hat Technology Sales team is looking for a Lightwell Specialist Solution Architect (SSA) to join our team.
raw.description:
The Red Hat Technology Sales team is looking for a Lightwell Specialist Solution Architect (SSA) to join our team. This position assumes a crucial role in providing expert deep technical sales support for the seamless execution of Go-To-Market (GTM) strategies related to Red Hat Lightwell.

Your primary focus will be to remove the organizational, technical, and competitive blockers to adoption of Red Hat Lightwell, making Red Hat the source our customers' applications are built from. You will help customers close the vulnerability gap that sits between their own application code and the platform beneath it so that remediation stops consuming engineering capacity they would rather spend on their business. You will need to confidently articulate our value proposition to developers, build and platform engineers, application development leadership, and the security and compliance organization within the account, changing register as you move between them. This will entail hands-on work in the customer's own build environment, technical architecture walk-throughs, business-value conversations framed in engineering cost, customer-facing technical workshops, and implementation of best practices in dependency management, artifact signing, attestation, and pipeline enforcement. Adoption is ultimately a developer decision, and proving it in their build is the most persuasive conversation you will have.

You will work closely with the Lightwell business unit and engineering, helping to test, document, and demonstrate cutting-edge features, and carrying coverage gaps, ecosystem requests, and competitive intelligence back to the business unit as a defined part of the role. You will also work in close collaboration with Red Hat sales, Customer Success, Consulting Services, and partner teams to ensure a highly positive customer experience.

What you will do:

  • Deploy into requested engagements as Red Hat's technical lead for trusted software supply chain, partnering with the Account Solution Architect and Account Executive to drive Red Hat Lightwell within new and existing customer accounts

  • Lead the technical conversation across three distinct audiences: developers and build engineers, application development and platform engineering leadership, and the security and compliance organization, adapting depth and framing to each.

  • Articulate and defend Red Hat's differentiating position against alternative approaches in the market.

  • Position the software supply chain offerings within the broader Red Hat portfolio, including hardened container images, artifact signing, attestation, SBOM generation, pipeline policy enforcement, and runtime security.

  • Prove the offering in the customer's environment, configuring their build to resolve against Lightwell repositories, executing their build, and troubleshooting the result alongside their engineers.

  • Facilitate pre, and post-sales activities when needed, including technical deep dives, proofs of concept, “bake-offs,” internal sprints and hackathons, and development of partner vertical-specific solutions to drive adoption of Red Hat Lightwell.

  • Identify and partner with customer stakeholders, acting as an advocate within both their line-of-business and internal customer teams.

  • Advise on integration with the customer's existing artifact management, mirroring, and pipeline estate, including disconnected and air-gapped environments.

  • Work closely with the Lightwell business unit and engineering teams, providing a market feedback loop on the product and solutions.

  • Execute community outreach and customer advocacy activities including conference speaking, blog posts, etc.

  • Deliver enablement and mentoring to the Red Hat Technical Sales community to raise baseline capability on software supply chain security.

What you will bring:

Experience

  • 6+ years in a combination of software engineering, build/release engineering, platform engineering, DevSecOps, or technical sales, including direct responsibility for software that carried real dependency and upgrade obligations.

  • Demonstrated ability to work hands-on in a customer or production build environment.

Application development and build systems

  • Working command of at least two of Maven, pip, and npm, including dependency resolution, transitive dependency behavior, lockfiles, and version constraint semantics.

  • Practical understanding of how enterprise builds are configured, where registry and repository settings are applied, and how enterprises currently proxy and mirror public package registries.

  • Hands-on experience with enterprise artifact repositories and internal mirrors.

  • Ability to work directly in a customer's build environment, configuring, executing, and troubleshooting builds alongside their engineers.

  • Understanding of build reproducibility, disconnected and air-gapped delivery, and multi-language codebases.

Software supply chain security

  • SLSA build integrity levels and the practical requirements of Level 3.

  • SBOM formats and lifecycle, including SPDX and CycloneDX, and the operational difference between generating an SBOM and acting on one.

  • Artifact signing and verification, including HSM-backed signing, attestation, and enforcement at build and admission.

  • VEX and CSAF, and the role of machine-readable exploitability data in vulnerability triage at scale.

  • Provenance, typosquatting, and dependency confusion threat models.

  • Understanding of upstream open source contribution practice and how remediations are returned to originating projects.

Communication and judgment

  • Experience delivering technical presentations and leading business value sessions.

  • Credibility with a working engineering audience and the presence to hold a leadership or executive conversation, including public speaking.

  • Ability to represent product coverage and roadmap accurately and without overstatement, particularly where curated coverage does not yet extend.

  • Willingness to travel as needed to meet the needs of the business and our customers.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience as a sales engineer, technical sales, or similar role preferably at an enterprise software company, a SaaS company, or Systems Integrator

  • Professional software development experience in Java or Python ecosystems, including responsibility for dependency management and release.

  • Ownership of CI/CD systems, artifact repositories, or internal developer platforms at enterprise scale.

  • DevSecOps experience, including integrating security tooling and policy into delivery pipelines, and familiarity with the organizational friction between security, platform, and application teams.

  • Application security or product security experience, including vulnerability management, dependency risk, or secure development lifecycle work.

  • Sustained participation in an upstream open source project, particularly in packaging, release engineering, or maintenance.

  • Foundational knowledge of Red Hat Enterprise Linux, OpenShift, and Ansible Automation Platform.

  • Familiarity with the compliance regimes relevant to the geography's key accounts, and with control automation as the durable answer to audit obligation.

About Red Hat

Red Hat is the world’s leading provider of enterpriseopen source software solutions, using a community-powered approach to deliver high-performing Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes technologies. Spread across 40+ countries, our associates work flexibly across work environments, from in-office, to office-flex, to fully remote, depending on the requirements of their role. Red Hatters are encouraged to bring their best ideas, no matter their title or tenure. We're a leader in open source because of our open and inclusive environment. We hire creative, passionate people ready to contribute their ideas, help solve complex problems, and make an impact.

Inclusion at Red Hat
Red Hat’s culture is built on the open source principles of transparency, collaboration, and inclusion, where the best ideas can come from anywhere and anyone. When this is realized, it empowers people from different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences to come together to share ideas, challenge the status quo, and drive innovation. Our aspiration is that everyone experiences this culture with equal opportunity and access, and that all voices are not only heard but also celebrated. We hope you will join our celebration, and we welcome and encourage applicants from all the beautiful dimensions that compose our global village.

Equal Opportunity Policy (EEO)
Red Hat is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We review applications for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

We are not responsible for, and will not pay, any fees, commissions, or any other payment related to unsolicited resumes or CVs except as required in a written contract between Red Hat and the recruitment agency or party requesting payment of a fee.

Solventum is a new healthcare company with a long legacy of solving big challenges that improve lives and help healthcare professionals perform at their best. Guided by empathy, insight, and clinical intelligence, we collaborate with the best minds in healthcare to address our customers’ toughest challenges. Please note that all listed roles are Solventum positions, and our Privacy Policy: applies to any personal information you submit. As it was with 3M, at Solventum all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

Job Description:

ML Engineer

3M Health Care is now Solventum

At Solventum, we enable better, smarter, safer healthcare to improve lives. As a new company with a long legacy of creating breakthrough solutions for our customers’ toughest challenges, we pioneer game-changing innovations at the intersection of health, material and data science that change patients' lives for the better while enabling healthcare professionals to perform at their best. Because people, and their wellbeing, are at the heart of every scientific advancement we pursue.

We partner closely with the brightest minds in healthcare to ensure that every solution we create melds the latest technology with compassion and empathy. Because at Solventum, we never stop solving for you.

The Impact You’ll Make in this Role

As an ML Engineer, you will be responsible for building and maintaining the pipelines that power AI in our Healthcare Information Systems (HIS). We are looking for a practical, detail-oriented engineer who is passionate about MLOps, data reliability, and production stability.

In this role, you won’t just be building models; you will be ensuring those models work reliably in the real world. You will help bridge the gap between data science and software engineering by implementing automated workflows, managing cloud infrastructure, and ensuring our AI services are secure and scalable.

Key Responsibilities

1. MLOps & Deployment

  • Pipeline Development: Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for machine learning, focusing on automated testing, model deployment, and version control (using tools like MLflow or Git).

  • Model Serving: Deploy ML models as scalable APIs and microservices, ensuring they meet performance and latency requirements for clinical use.

  • Monitoring: Implement basic monitoring tools to track model performance, data drift, and system health in production.

2. Data Engineering & Integration

  • Data Pipelines: Develop and optimize ETL processes to transform healthcare data (FHIR, HL7) into clean, usable datasets for model training and inference.

  • Feature Management: Help build and maintain feature stores and data layers that ensure consistency between training and production environments.

  • System Integration: Work closely with backend teams to integrate ML outputs into our core healthcare applications.

3. Engineering Best Practices

  • Code Quality: Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented Python code. Participate in code reviews to ensure system reliability.

  • Containerization: Use Docker and Kubernetes to package and orchestrate ML workloads across different environments.

  • Security & Compliance: Follow established protocols to ensure all data handling and deployments meet HIPAA and HITRUST security standards.

Your Skills and Expertise
To set you up for success in this role from day one, Solventum requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related field.

  • 3–5 years of professional experience in software engineering or data engineering, with at least 2 years focused on machine learning production environments.

AND

SAP Data Migration Consultant - Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: SAP Data Migration Consultant
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$175,000 Annually
Experience Required: 12+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced SAP Data Migration Consultant to design, execute, and support large-scale data migration initiatives within SAP S/4HANA environments. This role focuses on the full data migration lifecycle — extraction, transformation, validation, reconciliation, and cutover — to ensure accurate, complete, and compliant migration of enterprise data from legacy systems into SAP. The ideal candidate will combine strong hands-on experience with SAP LTMC, SLT, LVM, and S/4HANA migration tools with deep understanding of SAP data structures, business processes, and data governance, and will partner closely with functional teams, business owners, and infrastructure stakeholders during all phases of migration.
Key Responsibilities
  • Design and execute SAP data migration strategies for S/4HANA implementations, including conversion and greenfield scenarios.
  • Perform data extraction from legacy systems using SAP-provided and custom tools and prepare data for ingestion into SAP.
  • Configure and utilize SAP LTMC (Legacy Transfer Migration Cockpit), including custom migration objects where required.
  • Implement real-time replication scenarios using SAP SLT (System Landscape Transformation), including transformation rules and filter conditions.
  • Manage logical system setups and replication configurations for hybrid SAP environments.
  • Support system refreshes and landscape virtualization activities using SAP LVM (Landscape Virtualization Management).
  • Design and execute data transformation, cleansing, and enrichment processes prior to migration.
  • Develop comprehensive validation and reconciliation reports to ensure data accuracy and completeness.
  • Identify and resolve data inconsistencies, duplicates, and orphan records prior to go-live.
  • Support mock migrations, dress rehearsals, and the final cutover, including detailed runbook execution and rollback planning.
  • Optimize performance for large-volume data loads, including parallelization, package sizing, and database tuning.
  • Collaborate with functional teams to validate master and transactional data against business expectations.
  • Ensure compliance with enterprise data governance, audit, and privacy standards.
  • Maintain comprehensive, current technical documentation — including architecture diagrams, design decisions, configuration references, runbooks, and operational procedures — so that the system remains supportable, auditable, and easy to onboard new engineers onto over time.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Five or more years of SAP data migration experience.
  • Strong hands-on experience with SAP LTMC and S/4HANA migration tools.
  • Experience with SAP SLT replication scenarios.
  • Working knowledge of SAP LVM for system refresh and landscape management.
  • Strong understanding of SAP master and transactional data structures.
  • Experience performing data validation and reconciliation processes.
  • Strong SQL and data analysis skills.
  • Experience working in enterprise SAP landscapes during major implementations.
  • Strong troubleshooting and documentation skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience participating in S/4HANA greenfield or brownfield implementations.
  • Exposure to SAP Data Services or other ETL platforms.
  • Experience with high-volume, multi-source data migrations.
  • Working knowledge of SAP HANA database structures.
  • SAP S/4HANA certification.
How to Apply

For immediate consideration, please send your resume to or contact us at (908) 505-3899. Learn more about Bright Vision Technologies at www.bvteck.com.

Position offered by “No Fee Agency.”

Canonical ist ein globales softwareunternehmen, das Ubuntu und Open-Source-Unternehmenslösungen für Cloud, Entwicklung, IoT und KI veröffentlicht. Ubuntu ist die am schnellsten wachsende Linux-Distribution und gilt als das führende Betriebssystem in der Cloud.

In Zusammenarbeit mit Google, Amazon, IBM und Microsoft unterstützt Canonical Unternehmen dabei, agiler, produktiver zu werden und neue Technologien schneller zu übernehmen. Beispiele für Kundenerfolge umfassen KI, Blockchain, IoT, fortschrittliche Robotik und selbstfahrende Autos, bei denen Ubuntu die bevorzugte Entwicklungsplattform ist.

Die Rolle eines Sales Development Representative bei Canonical

Canonical ist profitabel und wächst. Wir betrachten unsere Vertriebsentwicklungsorganisation als die beste Technologie-Vertriebsakademie auf dem Markt und wählen daher außergewöhnliche und ambitionierte Kandidaten für unser Team aus. Diese Rolle wird Ihnen Freude bereiten, wenn Sie organisiert, hartnäckig, charismatisch und fleißig sind. Sie sollten Interesse an Technologie und ihren geschäftlichen Auswirkungen haben. Klicken Sie HIER, um zu sehen, wie unser SDR-Team seine Rolle bei Canonical bespricht

Wie der Tag aussehen wird

  • Bearbeiten von eingehende Kundenanfragen per E-Mail, Telefon und Chat
  • Durchführen von ausgehende Vertriebs- und Marketingkampagnen
  • Reisen zu Veranstaltungen und Konferenzen weltweit, Präsentationen an Ständen halten und persönliche Marketing- und Vertriebsmöglichkeiten fördern
  • Zusammenarbeiten mit verschiedenen Teams und hochrangigen Stakeholdern, um Ergebnisse zu erzielen
  • Direktes Zusammenarbeiten mit dem Marketing bei Kampagnen
  • Recherche von Informationen über potenzielle Kunden
  • Generieren einer Pipeline im Millionenbereich
  • Identifizieren von Markttrends
  • Mitwirkung bei der Definition von Prozessen und Richtlinien für das Team
  • Kontakt mit neuen und bestehenden Kunden, Einrichtung und Teilnahme an Besprechungen sowie aktive Kontaktpflege zur Identifizierung neuer Möglichkeiten
  • Erstellen, aktualisieren und pflegen von Leads für globale Chancen.

Was wir suchen

  • Hervorragende schulische und universitäre Leistungen
  • Leidenschaft für Wirtschaft und Technologie
  • Engagement für kontinuierliches Lernen und Verbesserung – neugierig, flexibel, wissenschaftlich orientiert
  • Kreatives Problemlösen und teamübergreifende Zusammenarbeit
  • Mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten
  • Ergebnisorientiert mit einem Überfliegergeist
  • Beharrlichkeit und Ausdauer

Was wir bieten

Das Grundgehalt hängt von verschiedenen Faktoren ab, darunter Ihrem geografischen Standort, dem Erfahrungsniveau, den Kenntnissen und Fähigkeiten. Neben den oben genannten Vorteilen haben bestimmte Rollen auch Anspruch auf zusätzliche Vorteile und Prämien, einschließlich Jahresboni und Verkaufsanreize basierend auf Umsatz oder Auslastung. Unsere Vergütungsphilosophie zielt darauf ab, Gerechtigkeit in unserer globalen Belegschaft sicherzustellen.

Neben einer wettbewerbsfähigen Grundvergütung bieten wir allen Teammitgliedern zusätzliche Leistungen, die unsere Werte und Ideale widerspiegeln. Bitte beachten Sie, dass je nach Arbeitsort zusätzliche Leistungen gelten können. Für weitere Informationen hierzu wenden Sie sich bitte an Ihren Talent Partner.

  • Jährliche Überprüfung der Vergütung
  • Anerkennungsprämien
  • Jährlicher Urlaub
  • Elternurlaub
  • Mitarbeiterhilfsprogramm
  • Möglichkeit, an neue Standorte zu reisen, um Kollegen bei „Sprints“ zu treffen
  • Priority Pass für Reisen und Reise-Upgrades für Firmenveranstaltungen auf Langstrecken

Canonical ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit bietet

Wir sind stolz darauf, einen Arbeitsplatz ohne Diskriminierung zu fördern. Vielfalt an Erfahrungen, Perspektiven und Hintergründen schaffen ein besseres Arbeitsumfeld und bessere Produkte. Unabhängig von Ihrer Identität werden wir Ihre Bewerbung fair berücksichtigen.

This job is responsible for the overall management and technical oversight of an actuarial staff (fellows, associates, actuarial candidates, and/or support personnel) where activities are concerned with pricing and rate development; overseeing assigned actuarial staff and projects and developing and implementing sound actuarial policies and practices to help Highmark meet its financial objectives; providing technical support for other areas such as Product Management & Development, Underwriting & Rating, and Sales.

Principal PLM Solution Architect – Oracle Cloud

JOB SUMMARY:

A Solution Architect at Argano is a highly experienced professional in the consulting family responsible for providing solution leadership to mid to large size client engagements and contributing to the growth and development of the consulting practice. The ideal candidate will be a consummate professional who can thrive in an upbeat and innovative environment and collaborate with clients to deliver a state-of-the-art solution. The individual will excel at delivering high quality service and cutting-edge solutions to Argano clients in the Oracle community. The Oracle Cloud PLM Solution Architect will focus on guiding and assisting clients through all phases of Oracle PLM Cloud implementation. The Oracle Cloud PLM Solution Architect is expected to have expertise in implementing a wide range of Oracle Cloud applications. The successful candidate will have completed five successful Oracle Cloud implementations. An Oracle Cloud PLM Solution Architect is responsible for the overall Enterprise Cloud solution. The Solution Architect will lead the implementation team in all phases of the implementation. This individual will identify and apply creative and innovative approaches to resolving product implementation and integration obstacles. They provide expert advice, guidance, and solutions related to technology to businesses and organizations. Their goal is to help clients optimize their technology infrastructure, processes, and strategies to achieve their business objectives more efficiently and effectively.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Lead mid to large size and complex consulting projects simultaneously.
  • Extensive whole lifecycle experience in leading Oracle SaaS requirements workshops, solutions architecture & design discussions.
  • Using in-depth knowledge of Oracle Cloud Applications, as well as industry best practice expertise, consults with clients to provide cost-effective solutions to client business scenarios.
  • Leads the implementation team in creating the overall Enterprise Cloud solution. This includes both the technical and functional solutions.
  • Experience in extending Oracle SaaS footprints with PaaS extensions. This involves designing solutions and writing specifications to create custom applications and integrating them with Oracle Cloud Applications.
  • Analyze current systems and data to identify new requirements, recognizing the need for systems enhancements or modifications if necessary.
  • Ability to lead, mentor, train, and guide an Oracle Cloud PLM applications team.
  • Experience in mapping enterprise requirements to multiple applications in the Oracle SaaS Applications.
  • Identifies and applies creative and innovative approaches to resolving product implementation and integration obstacles and problems.
  • Develop and implement long-term client strategies.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for clients. Effectively communicate with clients, team members, and stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle. Keep all parties informed about project progress, challenges, and changes.
  • Actively engage project stakeholders in the estimation process, mindful of the impact of strategic business changes.
  • Support business partners in presenting solution value to key stakeholders effectively.
  • Collaborate with third-party vendors and suppliers to source necessary hardware, software, or services. Negotiate contracts and agreements to secure the best terms for the client.
  • Present compelling business cases, clearly quantifying the benefits of proposed solutions.
  • Continuously monitor the performance of implemented solutions to identify areas for improvement or optimization. Provide recommendations for updates, upgrades, or modifications as needed.

MINIMUM AND/OR PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

EDUCATION:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field such as Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Engineering, etc.

EXPERIENCE:

  • Minimum 10 years of experience as Oracle Functional consultant with 3+ years of experience in solution design for PLM cloud implementations.
  • Expert level experience as an Oracle Cloud Architect implementing or supporting Oracle Cloud implementation projects and upgrades.
  • Experience with Oracle Platform as a Service (PaaS) with a focus on Integration Cloud Service, Database Cloud Service.
  • Knowledgeable and experience with Web Services and the use of Oracle Cloud delivered Web Services (SOAP & REST).
  • Expert consulting experience and business analytical skills to gather and document business requirements, leading fit-gap analysis, business process designs, managing conference room pilots (CRPs), perform functional configuration, and manage testing of PLM solutions.
  • Experience in navigating the challenges of working with cross-border and diverse teams and projects.
  • Understanding of best practice product lifecycle management processes and/or new product development/introduction process requirements.
  • Expert level experience with one or more of the following Oracle Cloud Applications:
    • Oracle Cloud Product Development
    • Oracle Cloud Product Data Hub
    • Oracle Cloud Innovation Management
    • Oracle Cloud Quality Management
    • Oracle Cloud Project Management
  • Strong consulting experience and business analytical skills to gather and document business requirements, leading fit-gap analysis, business process designs, managing conference room pilots (CRPs), perform functional configuration, and manage testing of PLM solutions.
  • Proven experience with guiding clients through business process improvements.
  • Excellent interpersonal, organizational, presentation, and communication skills.
  • High commitment to exceed performance expectations.
  • Ability to write functional specification based on user requirements.
  • Senior enough to be able to independently handle client expectations.
  • Professional approach when dealing with internal and external customers.
  • Ability to maintain a positive attitude under stressful circumstances.
  • Willingness to travel as needed.
  • Preferred consulting experience in a similar role in a professional services firm or industry experience at a strategic level is required.
  • Previous experience working in IT companies.
  • In-depth knowledge of the technologies and systems relevant.
  • Creating a positive environment by monitoring workloads of the team while meeting client expectations.

SKILL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Communication: Proficient in English written and verbal communications. Excellent verbal and written communication skills to interact with clients, team members, and stakeholders.
  • Complex Project Management: Solution Architects are responsible for leading multiple complex projects, necessitating exceptional project management skills.
  • Thought Leadership: Providing thought leadership and industry expertise is critical in projects.
  • Client Acquisition: They should have strong business development skills to acquire new clients and expand existing relationships.
  • Mentorship and Coaching: Indirectly developing and coaching junior and mid-level consultants is a significant responsibility.
  • Strategic Vision: Solution Architects should contribute to the firm’s strategic vision and decision-making.
  • Executive Presence: The ability to interact effectively with senior client executives is important.

raw.description:
Kindly note that this vacancy is for MIIS (Middlebury Institute of International Studies at Monterey) students only.

=================================================================

Hours: 15-20 hours per week

Location: home-based

Travel: none

Reporting to: Senior Project Officer

MIIS Students may be eligible for the Experiential Learning Fund (ELF). For more information please visit:

Are you a MIIS student with a unique internship idea based on your area of interest and expertise? Apply to any open MIIS internship posting, upload your resume, and outline your proposal in your cover letter.

CLEAR Global is an equal-opportunity employer, committed to having a diverse team where individuals of all backgrounds collaborate and learn from one another. We believe we can be most effective with diverse experience and expertise in our team. We recruit on merit, actively seek diverse applicant pools, and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. We do not discriminate on the basis of disability, age, gender identity and expression, national origin, race and ethnicity, religious beliefs, marital or parental status, or sexual orientation, and welcome all types of diversity.

Background

The Project Management Team at CLEAR Global handles a wide range of exciting projects, including language services, voice data collection, research, and technology initiatives.

The Project Management Intern - Medical Translations will collaborate closely with the Project Management Team in coordinating translation projects for our partners focused on health, ensuring that they are completed efficiently, in line with internal processes and partner expectations.

Objectives

The main objective of this internship is to support delivery of language services projects to CLEAR Global partners from the health sector, and to ensure linguists from our community are supported and remain engaged around these projects.

The role

The MIIS Project Management Intern - Medical Translations will support coordinating collaboration among different stakeholders, ensuring engagement, appropriate levels of expected output quality, and turnaround. They will also assist with internal processes necessary for the effective planning, coordination, and compliance of activities.

They will support the Project Management Team in coordinating translation projects, ensuring they are completed efficiently and within the expectations of CLEAR Global management and partners. They will coordinate collaboration among translators on specific tasks, providing engagement, appropriate levels of translation quality and turnaround, as well as track progress of translation tasks and credit linguists for their work.

Responsibilities

  • Manage specific language service projects as assigned by Project Officers;
  • Upload and download project files, run pre- and post-production checks;
  • Track project progress and delivery, keep project trackers up-to-date, and provide regular status updates to Project Officers;
  • Maintain an organized project environment across platforms, maintaining project records, files and databases as assigned;
  • Assist with building and managing translator teams, as well as general translator recruitment, as requested by Project Officers;
  • Maintain effective communication with translators throughout the project, ensuring that translators remain engaged throughout the project and have a clear understanding of project expectations;
  • Carry out translator communications around translation quality and turnaround, replying to translators’ messages, ensuring task pick-up, flagging issues, etc;
  • Handle other project management tasks as assigned;
  • Act in the best interest of the organization during the project period.

These roles and responsibilities are approximate and may change over time.

Qualifications

  • Current graduate student at the Middlebury Institute of International Studies (MIIS)
  • Excellent command of English. Knowledge of other languages is an advantage;
  • Previous experience in translation and/or interpreting (internships and volunteering are considered valid experiences) is desirable;
  • Previous experience working with non-profit organizations is desirable;
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
  • Strong writing skills in English;
  • Knowledge of CAT tools is a plus.

Requirements

This position is very dynamic. The right person is an energetic team player who agrees with CLEAR Global’s basic beliefs and values and can work remotely while interacting regularly with the international team.

  • Self-starter;
  • Strong organizational skills;
  • Analytical thinker able to transform ideas into tangible actions;
  • Understands that communication in the right language is key to improved humanitarian response;
  • Team player, collaborative, adaptable and self-motivated;
  • Interest in acquiring translation project management experience;
  • Ability to adapt to new technologies and learn new skills quickly;
  • Attention to detail

About CLEAR Global

CLEAR Global exists to help people get vital information, and be heard, whatever language they speak. We believe that everyone has the right to give and receive information in a language and format they understand. We work with nonprofit partners and a global community of language professionals to build local language translation capacity, and raise awareness of language barriers. Our network of over 200,000 community members translate millions of words of life-saving and life-changing information a year.

Core values

CLEAR Global employees and volunteers are people who believe passionately about the value of this work and take personal responsibility for achieving the mission. CLEAR Global’s mission and organizational spirit embody the core values established in its strategic framework:

  • Excellence: As the leading voice for communicating humanitarian information in the right language, CLEAR Global is a leader in the translation industry and in the non-profit sector.
  • Integrity: CLEAR Global believes that every person, whether it’s the people who we serve, our volunteers or our staff, has value, deserves respect and has inherent dignity.
  • Empowerment: CLEAR Global believes in using language to empower people around the world to control their own development and destiny.
  • Innovation: CLEAR Global recognizes and celebrates the power of innovation to address humanitarian and crisis issues around the world.
  • Sustainability: CLEAR Global recognizes that meeting our mission necessitates establishment and maintenance of a solid financial and organizational infrastructure.
  • Tolerance: Our staff and volunteers are highly knowledgeable and skilled; value each other, our partner and our recipients; create a supportive work environment; and, conduct themselves professionally at all times.

CLEAR Global may re-advertise the vacancy, cancel the recruitment, offer an appointment with a modified job description or for a different duration at its discretion.

Business Development Manager

Company Introduction

PatientFi® is a technology-based, point-of-sale financing company in Irvine, CA that partners with healthcare providers to offer patients a friendly payment solution for out-of-pocket medical and dental procedures. The company serves various healthcare specialties, including plastic surgery, dermatology, ophthalmology, dentistry, fertility, and medical spas. PatientFi is a Series B company backed by leading venture capital and private equity investors and was recently named #54 on Deloitte’s Fast 500 list.

Job Description

The Business Development Manager is a pivotal role at PatientFi. Through their efforts, Business Development Managers drive revenue by identifying, qualifying, and selling Practices on the value of the PatientFi platform. Business Development Managers must be able to multitask, self-manage, and operate in a fast-paced, ever-changing startup environment.

Responsibilities

  • Prospect, qualify, and close elective medical practices (Plastic Surgery, Medical Spa, Dermatology, etc.) on the value of PatientFi’s financing & membership offerings

About the Company
Our client is a small U.S.-based consultancy that helps founders and marketing teams organize knowledge, processes, and AI-enabled workflows.
The team is lean and distributed, with Notion as its central operational hub and AI tools used to improve research, documentation, and execution.
About the Role
We are looking for a proactive Operations & Executive Assistant to keep projects, systems, and recurring responsibilities moving forward.
This is primarily an operations role. You will manage workflows in Notion, coordinate deadlines, maintain CRM and documentation, follow up with team members and contractors, and make sure operational details do not fall through the cracks.
You must already be comfortable using Notion and AI tools in your day-to-day work. We value people who can independently prioritize, identify blockers, research solutions, and take the next reasonable action without waiting for detailed instructions.
Why This Opportunity?
This role offers the opportunity to work directly with a U.S.-based founder while taking meaningful ownership of day-to-day operations, systems, and workflows.
You'll work hands-on with Notion, AI, project coordination, CRM, and process improvement, with the autonomy to help build better operational systems rather than simply execute a static administrative checklist.
What You'll Do
  • Manage projects, tasks, owners, due dates, dependencies, and recurring workflows in Notion.
  • Review overdue tasks, missing owners, unanswered requests, and stalled projects, following up proactively to keep work moving.
  • Turn disorganized requests into clear next actions and prepare concise updates on priorities, risks, blockers, and decisions needed.
  • Maintain Notion databases, CRM records, SOPs, internal documentation, and Google Drive resources.
  • Use AI tools for research, synthesis, documentation, meeting preparation, summaries, SOP creation, drafting, and routine operational support, validating outputs before use.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify, document, or improve recurring processes using Notion, AI, and better workflows.
  • Track executive commitments, approvals, follow-ups, and decisions; prepare agendas and convert meeting decisions into assigned tasks and deadlines.
  • Coordinate contractor onboarding, access, invoices, time logs, subscriptions, renewals, and basic administrative logistics.
  • Research vendors, tools, services, and operational questions and recommend practical next steps.
  • Support lightweight marketing operations such as scheduling approved content and uploading website, email, or social content when needed.
Qualifications
Required Qualifications
  • Experience in operations, project coordination, executive support, or a similar operational role.
  • Hands-on Notion experience with databases, tasks/projects, templates, properties, views, and filters.
  • Professional experience using AI tools in daily workflows for research, synthesis, documentation, drafting, or operational support.
  • Experience managing multiple projects, deadlines, recurring responsibilities, and CRM/project-management systems.
  • Strong organization, prioritization, attention to detail, and follow-through.
  • Ability to independently research problems, propose practical solutions, and adjust as priorities change.
  • Professional written and spoken English.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience supporting a founder, executive, or small professional-services business.
  • Experience reorganizing messy operational systems, maintaining SOPs, or improving recurring workflows.
  • Experience using AI to streamline recurring processes or administrative work.
  • Familiarity with Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, WordPress, or similar business tools.
  • Basic marketing operations or content scheduling experience.
How Success Is Measured
Success means projects and recurring responsibilities move forward without constant founder oversight; Notion and CRM remain organized and reliable; deadlines and blockers are proactively managed; and operational problems are surfaced with context and a proposed solution.
You will also help simplify or improve recurring processes using Notion, AI, and stronger operational workflows.
Why Join Us?
  • $1,800 – $2,200 USD/month.
  • Fully remote work in Latin America.
  • Direct exposure to the founder with significant autonomy and ownership.
  • Hands-on work with Notion, AI, systems, and process improvement.
  • Opportunity to build better operational systems rather than simply execute a static administrative checklist.
Important Notes
This is an operations-first position, not a traditional calendar-focused Executive Assistant role.
Candidates must already have practical Notion experience and professional experience using AI tools in their day-to-day work. We are looking for someone who can organize complexity, close loops, follow up confidently, and solve problems without constant supervision.

This is a remote/telecommute position.

About the Role

As a CRO / Website Optimization Specialist, you will own a client's website and quiz-funnel experimentation roadmap from opportunity identification through execution and analysis. This is not a strategy-only position: you will formulate hypotheses, build and launch tests yourself, analyze performance, and determine what should happen next.

You'll have meaningful autonomy across Shopify, landing pages, quizzes, cart optimization, analytics, and experimentation tools. The right person combines strong CRO judgment with the technical confidence to make changes independently without relying on the client to finish or troubleshoot the execution.

Working hours are Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM EST.

Responsibilities

  • Own the website and quiz-funnel experimentation roadmap, prioritizing opportunities based on customer behavior, data, and potential conversion impact.
  • Turn conversion opportunities into clear hypotheses with defined success metrics and a rationale for why each test is worth running.
  • Personally build, QA, and launch A/B tests using Intelligems or comparable experimentation platforms.
  • Make Shopify front-end changes independently, including landing page updates, merchandising improvements, UX changes, and conversion-focused site enhancements.
  • Build and optimize landing pages rather than relying solely on designers or developers to execute your recommendations.
  • Improve quizzes and personalization funnels using Digioh or comparable tools to increase engagement and progression through the purchase journey.
  • Optimize cart and upsell experiences using Rebuy, Smart Cart, or similar Shopify conversion tools.
  • Use GA4 and platform-level analytics to evaluate website behavior, conversion performance, event tracking, and experiment outcomes.
  • Translate experiment results into clear next steps, including follow-up tests, rollouts, iterations, or changes in roadmap priority.
  • Troubleshoot unfamiliar website and platform issues independently using documentation, support resources, AI tools, and structured problem-solving.

Requirements

Must-Have:

  • 3-6+ years of hands-on experience in CRO, e-commerce website optimization, growth, or a closely related role, with flexibility for candidates whose experience demonstrates equivalent depth.
  • Strong practical knowledge of e-commerce conversion optimization, including funnels, customer journeys, merchandising, UX, and key conversion levers.
  • Hands-on Shopify front-end experience with the ability to make and troubleshoot website changes independently.
  • Proven ownership of A/B testing from opportunity identification and hypothesis creation through implementation, analysis, and next-step recommendations.
  • Hands-on experience with Intelligems or a comparable experimentation platform, plus working knowledge of GA4 and website conversion analytics.
  • Ability to personally build landing pages and conversion experiences rather than only producing briefs for designers or developers.
  • Strong judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to follow detailed written or video instructions carefully when working with sensitive website or company information.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience using Digioh for quizzes, funnels, personalization, or comparable conversion experiences.
  • Experience with Rebuy, Smart Cart, or similar Shopify upsell and cart-optimization tools.
  • Direct experience working with DTC e-commerce brands.
  • Experience optimizing subscription-based e-commerce businesses.
  • Previous experience in a role that combined strategic CRO ownership with substantial hands-on execution.

Role Title: Lawyer/Legal Writer

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging Lawyer/Legal Writers to participate in an evaluation and analysis opportunity focused on advanced AI system development for a customer project. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters.

This is an evaluative engagement: you will assess and analyze written legal content, not provide legal advice or representation. There is no attorney-client relationship, and your professional judgment about written argument is the core value. The focus is on those skills lawyers employ daily — discerning whether writing is precise, properly qualified, pitched to the appropriate audience, and free from unwarranted overstatement. Recognizing confidently stated but unsupported writing is central to the project.

Scope of Work

  1. Evaluate and compare multiple AI-generated written responses to legal and technical prompts for clarity, tone, and compliance with instructions.
  2. Assign analytical quality scores and compose detailed rationales for each assessment.
  3. Identify responses that sound authoritative but lack precision, contain overstatements, or present unsupported claims.
  4. Detect inconsistencies, ambiguities, or factual inaccuracies in digital content.
  5. Document findings and insights meticulously in online review platforms.
  6. Collaborate asynchronously with project managers and reviewers to ensure consistent evaluation standards.
  7. Work independently while managing deliverables and deadlines per project requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. English as a first language or fully equivalent written fluency.
  2. Qualifying law degree from a university in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Ireland, Australia, or New Zealand.
  3. Demonstrated experience drafting briefs, motions, memoranda, legal opinions, or regulatory submissions.
  4. Background in reviewing, editing, or supervising legal writing by junior lawyers, trainees, or paralegals.
  5. Strong ability to assess whether content is tailored appropriately for legal, regulatory, client, or public audiences.
  6. Exceptional attention to detail, critical analysis, and written communication skills.
  7. Experience with digital document review platforms or annotation tools is desirable; familiarity with model evaluation or RLHF is a plus but not required.

Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

The Opportunity

Grafana Labs is looking for an Enterprise Account Executive, Acquisition based in Italy who will be responsible for prospecting and closing new business across Italy. You will identify, nurture and close opportunities with new customers, manage forecasts and track customer data. We're strong proponents of a consultative sales approach - learn about the customer's needs first before talking products. Your expertise will be critical in helping articulate the value of our products, work with the customer during the trial phase and hand off a strong relationship to our Growth team. Ideally, you come from a technical background and have sold technical products before.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Meet and exceed individual quarterly and annual sales goals
  • Outbound prospecting into net-new customers
  • Manage all aspects of the sales process (prospecting, sales meetings, product demos, proofs of concept, proposals, and negotiations)
  • Cultivate sales through outbound prospecting and inbound leads
  • Be able to understand and convey the value of both Grafana Cloud and Grafana Enterprise
  • Become an expert in managing your sales pipeline in Salesforce
  • Manage quote creation, order processing, and day-to-day customer requests

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • 5+ Years of experience in infrastructure technology sales
  • Demonstrated history of consistent goal achievement in a highly competitive environment (top 10% performer)
  • Energetic, upbeat, entrepreneurial, tenacious team player
  • Adaptable and with demonstrable experience in high velocity technology companies
  • You will need to be an excellent communicator in all channels (in person, online, in writing) and able to form strong working relationships both in person and virtually
  • Fluent in English & Italian.

Bonus Points For:

  • Familiarity with open source technology is a significant advantage
  • Experience using Salesforce
  • Experience using Command of the Message and MEDD(P)ICC is ideal

Compensation & Rewards

In Italy, the OTE compensation range for this role is EUR 170,000 - EUR 211,250. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

raw.description:
The role of an Engineering Manager at Canonical

As an Engineering Manager at Canonical, you must be technically strong, but your main responsibility is to run an effective team and develop the colleagues you manage. You will develop and review code as a leader, while at the same time staying aware of that the best way to improve the product is to ensure that the whole team is focused, productive and unblocked.

You are expected to help them grow as engineers, do meaningful work, do it outstandingly well, find professional and personal satisfaction, and work well with colleagues and the community. You will also be expected to be a positive influence on culture, facilitate technical delivery, and regularly reflect with your team on strategy and execution.

You will collaborate closely with other Engineering Managers, product managers, and architects, producing an engineering roadmap with ambitious and achievable goals.

We expect Engineering Managers to be fluent in the programming language, architecture, and components that their team uses, in this case popular open-source machine learning tools like Kubeflow, MLFlow, and Feast.

Code reviews and architectural leadership are part of the job. The commitment to healthy engineering practices, documentation, quality and performance optimisation is as important, as is the requirement for fair and clear management, and the obligation to ensure a high-performing team.

Location: This is a Globally remote role.

What your day will look like

  • Manage a distributed team of engineers and its MLOps/Analytics portfolio
  • Organize and lead the team’s processes in order to help it achieve its objectives
  • Conduct one-on-one meetings with team members
  • Identify and measure team health indicators
  • Interact with a vibrant community
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Attend conferences to represent Canonical and its MLOps solutions
  • Mentor and grow your direct reports, helping them achieve their professional goals
  • Work from home with global travel for 2 to 4 weeks per year for internal and external events

What we are looking for in you

  • A proven track record of professional experience of software delivery
  • Professional python development experience, preferably with a track record in open source
  • A proven understanding of the machine learning space, its challenges and opportunities to improve
  • Experience designing and implementing MLOps solutions
  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and preferably university
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events

Additional skills that you might also bring

The following skills may be helpful to you in the role, but we don't expect everyone to bring all of them.

  • Hands-on experience with machine learning libraries, or tools.
  • Proven track record of building highly automated machine learning solutions for the cloud.
  • Experience with building machine learning models
  • Experience with container technologies (Docker, LXD, Kubernetes, etc.)
  • Experience with public clouds (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)
  • Experience in the Linux and open-source software world
  • Working knowledge of cloud computing
  • Passionate about software quality and testing
  • Experience working on a distributed team on an open source project -- even if that is community open source contributions.
  • Demonstrated track record of Open Source contributions

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we’ve been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.

Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

raw.description:
This is a remote position.

AI Engineer — Data & Reporting Automation (Project Based)
Covers: AI Accounts Reporting + AI Internal Report

Company:TeamFicient

Location:Remote

Employment Type:Contract — Project-Based, Fixed-Scope
Rate:Proposed by candidate via RFQ (rate, timeline, and estimated hours)

Work Schedule:

  • Self-directed, solo execution of the full project scope

  • IT agent touchpoints and management check-ins only as needed to review progress

  • Timeline and hours are proposed by the candidate in their RFQ

Why Join Us?

At TeamFicient, our team spans multiple countries and regions, and we stay connected by operating within EST, CST, and PST time zones.

  • Work Without Borders: Collaborate daily with experts from worldwide and gain international exposure.

  • Built for Remote: Join a fully remote culture designed for autonomy, flexibility, and trust.

  • Diverse Perspectives: Be part of a multicultural team where different backgrounds are our greatest strength.

  • Grow Globally: Expand your career on a global stage, learning how business works across different cultures and continents.

About the Role

TeamFicient is looking for an AI Engineer to build automated, AI-assisted reporting environments — covering account-level and internal/management reporting — that consolidate data, validate KPIs, and produce recurring dashboards with minimal manual work. This is a two-project track, and a strong candidate can run both. This is a solo, fixed-scope engagement: you own execution end to end, with IT touchpoints and management check-ins only as needed. You'll submit your own RFQ (proposed approach, timeline, hours, and cost) as part of the process.

Core Responsibilities

Reporting & Data Integration

  • Integrate and consolidate data across multiple account/data sources into a unified reporting engine

  • Gather requirements and build dashboards for account-level and internal/management reporting

  • Validate KPI calculations against source data and build exception/error handling for bad data

Automation & AI

  • Automate data refreshes, recurring report production, and delivery scheduling

  • Generate AI-assisted summaries and management insights where appropriate

Documentation

  • Document data sources, refresh logic, dependencies, and maintenance procedures

Candidate Qualifications

Must-Haves

  • Strong hands-on experience with Google Sheets, Looker Studio, and Google Workspace automation

  • Experience integrating an AI/LLM service into a reporting or summarization workflow

  • Proven ability to design, validate, and document a KPI/reporting pipeline independently

  • Comfortable separating one-time build costs from recurring/usage-based costs (APIs, hosting)

Good to Haves

  • Experience with Asana or similar project-data integrations

  • Background in BI/dashboard work across multiple accounts or business units

Application Requirements

To apply for this project, please be prepared to submit:

  • A portfolio of relevant, comparable work

  • An RFQ (Request for Quotation) covering:

    • What you propose to do

    • How you would do it

    • What's included (and what's excluded)

    • Estimated timeline and hours

    • Total cost, plus any additional/recurring costs

    • What you'll need from TeamFicient to execute

    • Risks, limitations, and assumptions

  • Willingness to sign an NDA and Project Agreement before receiving full project details and credentials

  • Willingness to undergo a background check

Work Location: Remote

raw.description:
Canonical ist ein globales softwareunternehmen, das Ubuntu und Open-Source-Unternehmenslösungen für Cloud, Entwicklung, IoT und KI veröffentlicht. Ubuntu ist die am schnellsten wachsende Linux-Distribution und gilt als das führende Betriebssystem in der Cloud.

In Zusammenarbeit mit Google, Amazon, IBM und Microsoft unterstützt Canonical Unternehmen dabei, agiler, produktiver zu werden und neue Technologien schneller zu übernehmen. Beispiele für Kundenerfolge umfassen KI, Blockchain, IoT, fortschrittliche Robotik und selbstfahrende Autos, bei denen Ubuntu die bevorzugte Entwicklungsplattform ist.

Die Rolle eines Sales Development Representative bei Canonical

Canonical ist profitabel und wächst. Wir betrachten unsere Vertriebsentwicklungsorganisation als die beste Technologie-Vertriebsakademie auf dem Markt und wählen daher außergewöhnliche und ambitionierte Kandidaten für unser Team aus. Diese Rolle wird Ihnen Freude bereiten, wenn Sie organisiert, hartnäckig, charismatisch und fleißig sind. Sie sollten Interesse an Technologie und ihren geschäftlichen Auswirkungen haben. In dieser Position arbeiten Sie mit einem regionalen Vertriebs- und Marketingteam zusammen, und Ihr Hauptziel ist es, Kundenprojekte zu finden, die zu unseren Produktlinien passen, und den guten Ruf von Canonical in verschiedenen Branchen und Regionen zu verbreiten.

Klicken Sie HIER, um zu sehen, wie unser SDR-Team seine Rolle bei Canonical bespricht

Wie der Tag aussehen wird

  • Bearbeiten von eingehende Kundenanfragen per E-Mail, Telefon und Chat
  • Durchführen von ausgehende Vertriebs- und Marketingkampagnen
  • Reisen zu Veranstaltungen und Konferenzen weltweit, Präsentationen an Ständen halten und persönliche Marketing- und Vertriebsmöglichkeiten fördern
  • Zusammenarbeiten mit verschiedenen Teams und hochrangigen Stakeholdern, um Ergebnisse zu erzielen
  • Direktes Zusammenarbeiten mit dem Marketing bei Kampagnen
  • Recherche von Informationen über potenzielle Kunden
  • Generieren einer Pipeline im Millionenbereich
  • Identifizieren von Markttrends
  • Mitwirkung bei der Definition von Prozessen und Richtlinien für das Team
  • Kontakt mit neuen und bestehenden Kunden, Einrichtung und Teilnahme an Besprechungen sowie aktive Kontaktpflege zur Identifizierung neuer Möglichkeiten
  • Erstellen, aktualisieren und pflegen von Leads für globale Chancen.

Was wir suchen

  • Hervorragende schulische und universitäre Leistungen
  • Leidenschaft für Wirtschaft und Technologie
  • Engagement für kontinuierliches Lernen und Verbesserung – neugierig, flexibel, wissenschaftlich orientiert
  • Kreatives Problemlösen und teamübergreifende Zusammenarbeit
  • Mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten
  • Ergebnisorientiert mit einem Überfliegergeist
  • Beharrlichkeit und Ausdauer

Was wir bieten

Das Grundgehalt hängt von verschiedenen Faktoren ab, darunter Ihrem geografischen Standort, dem Erfahrungsniveau, den Kenntnissen und Fähigkeiten. Neben den oben genannten Vorteilen haben bestimmte Rollen auch Anspruch auf zusätzliche Vorteile und Prämien, einschließlich Jahresboni und Verkaufsanreize basierend auf Umsatz oder Auslastung. Unsere Vergütungsphilosophie zielt darauf ab, Gerechtigkeit in unserer globalen Belegschaft sicherzustellen.

Neben einer wettbewerbsfähigen Grundvergütung bieten wir allen Teammitgliedern zusätzliche Leistungen, die unsere Werte und Ideale widerspiegeln. Bitte beachten Sie, dass je nach Arbeitsort zusätzliche Leistungen gelten können. Für weitere Informationen hierzu wenden Sie sich bitte an Ihren Talent Partner.

  • Persönliches Lern- und Entwicklungsbudget in der Höhe von 2.000 USD pro Jahr
  • Jährliche Überprüfung der Vergütung
  • Anerkennungsprämien
  • Jährlicher Urlaub
  • Elternurlaub
  • Mitarbeiterhilfsprogramm
  • Möglichkeit, an neue Standorte zu reisen, um Kollegen bei „Sprints“ zu treffen
  • Priority Pass für Reisen und Reise-Upgrades für Firmenveranstaltungen auf Langstrecken

Canonical ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit bietet

Wir sind stolz darauf, einen Arbeitsplatz ohne Diskriminierung zu fördern. Vielfalt an Erfahrungen, Perspektiven und Hintergründen schaffen ein besseres Arbeitsumfeld und bessere Produkte. Unabhängig von Ihrer Identität werden wir Ihre Bewerbung fair berücksichtigen.

Company :

Highmark Inc.

Job Description :

JOB SUMMARY

This job is responsible for the overall management and technical oversight of an actuarial staff (fellows, associates, actuarial candidates, and/or support personnel) where activities are concerned with pricing and rate development; overseeing assigned actuarial staff and projects and developing and implementing sound actuarial policies and practices to help Highmark meet its financial objectives; providing technical support for other areas such as Product Management & Development, Underwriting & Rating, and Sales.

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Perform management responsibilities to include, but are not limited to: involved in hiring and termination decisions, coaching and development, rewards and recognition, performance management and staff productivity. Plan, organize, staff, direct and control the day-to-day operations of the department; develop and implement policies and programs as necessary; may have budgetary responsibility and authority.
  • Oversee the preparation of rate filings for large group, small group, direct pay, or senior products.
  • Work with Underwriting and Rating, Sales and Product Management and Development to develop and implement appropriate rating strategies for group, direct pay or senior lines of business. Ensure that all strategies are in compliance with rate filings and applicable regulations.
  • Provide advanced support for the claim reserve process.
  • Provide assistance and risk management to the Product Management and Development area for pricing development of new products. Ensure that all new products are financially viable and stable.
  • Determine underlying factors impacting pure premium trends for various products and regions. Monitor trends for use in rating. Identify any shifts in trend and take appropriate pricing actions.
  • Other duties as assigned or requested.

EDUCATION

Required

  • Bachelor’s Degree, with a strong emphasis in Actuarial Science, Mathematics and Statistics

Substitutions

  • None

Preferred

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Actuarial Science, Mathematics, or Statistics

EXPERIENCE

Minimum

  • 8 years in an Actuarial role
  • 5 years in a management role and/or leading teams and/or projects of varying size and complexity
  • Attainment of the ASA or ACAS (Associate) designation ANDpursuing FSA or FCAS (Fellowship) designation in the Society of Actuaries or Casualty Actuarial Society
  • Member of the American Academy of Actuaries (MAAA)

Preferred

  • 10 years in an Actuarial role
  • Attainment of FSA or FCAS (Fellowship) in the Society of Actuaries or Casualty Actuarial Society

SKILLS

  • Ability to apply extensive knowledge of actuarial methods and procedures

Principal PLM Solution Architect – Oracle Cloud

JOB SUMMARY:

A Solution Architect at Argano is a highly experienced professional in the consulting family responsible for providing solution leadership to mid to large size client engagements and contributing to the growth and development of the consulting practice. The ideal candidate will be a consummate professional who can thrive in an upbeat and innovative environment and collaborate with clients to deliver a state-of-the-art solution. The individual will excel at delivering high quality service and cutting-edge solutions to Argano clients in the Oracle community. The Oracle Cloud PLM Solution Architect will focus on guiding and assisting clients through all phases of Oracle PLM Cloud implementation. The Oracle Cloud PLM Solution Architect is expected to have expertise in implementing a wide range of Oracle Cloud applications. The successful candidate will have completed five successful Oracle Cloud implementations. An Oracle Cloud PLM Solution Architect is responsible for the overall Enterprise Cloud solution. The Solution Architect will lead the implementation team in all phases of the implementation. This individual will identify and apply creative and innovative approaches to resolving product implementation and integration obstacles. They provide expert advice, guidance, and solutions related to technology to businesses and organizations. Their goal is to help clients optimize their technology infrastructure, processes, and strategies to achieve their business objectives more efficiently and effectively.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Lead mid to large size and complex consulting projects simultaneously.
  • Extensive whole lifecycle experience in leading Oracle SaaS requirements workshops, solutions architecture & design discussions.
  • Using in-depth knowledge of Oracle Cloud Applications, as well as industry best practice expertise, consults with clients to provide cost-effective solutions to client business scenarios.
  • Leads the implementation team in creating the overall Enterprise Cloud solution. This includes both the technical and functional solutions.
  • Experience in extending Oracle SaaS footprints with PaaS extensions. This involves designing solutions and writing specifications to create custom applications and integrating them with Oracle Cloud Applications.
  • Analyze current systems and data to identify new requirements, recognizing the need for systems enhancements or modifications if necessary.
  • Ability to lead, mentor, train, and guide an Oracle Cloud PLM applications team.
  • Experience in mapping enterprise requirements to multiple applications in the Oracle SaaS Applications.
  • Identifies and applies creative and innovative approaches to resolving product implementation and integration obstacles and problems.
  • Develop and implement long-term client strategies.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for clients. Effectively communicate with clients, team members, and stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle. Keep all parties informed about project progress, challenges, and changes.
  • Actively engage project stakeholders in the estimation process, mindful of the impact of strategic business changes.
  • Support business partners in presenting solution value to key stakeholders effectively.
  • Collaborate with third-party vendors and suppliers to source necessary hardware, software, or services. Negotiate contracts and agreements to secure the best terms for the client.
  • Present compelling business cases, clearly quantifying the benefits of proposed solutions.
  • Continuously monitor the performance of implemented solutions to identify areas for improvement or optimization. Provide recommendations for updates, upgrades, or modifications as needed.

MINIMUM AND/OR PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

EDUCATION:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field such as Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Engineering, etc.

EXPERIENCE:

  • Minimum 10 years of experience as Oracle Functional consultant with 3+ years of experience in solution design for PLM cloud implementations.
  • Expert level experience as an Oracle Cloud Architect implementing or supporting Oracle Cloud implementation projects and upgrades.
  • Experience with Oracle Platform as a Service (PaaS) with a focus on Integration Cloud Service, Database Cloud Service.
  • Knowledgeable and experience with Web Services and the use of Oracle Cloud delivered Web Services (SOAP & REST).
  • Expert consulting experience and business analytical skills to gather and document business requirements, leading fit-gap analysis, business process designs, managing conference room pilots (CRPs), perform functional configuration, and manage testing of PLM solutions.
  • Experience in navigating the challenges of working with cross-border and diverse teams and projects.
  • Understanding of best practice product lifecycle management processes and/or new product development/introduction process requirements.
  • Expert level experience with one or more of the following Oracle Cloud Applications:
    • Oracle Cloud Product Development
    • Oracle Cloud Product Data Hub
    • Oracle Cloud Innovation Management
    • Oracle Cloud Quality Management
    • Oracle Cloud Project Management
  • Strong consulting experience and business analytical skills to gather and document business requirements, leading fit-gap analysis, business process designs, managing conference room pilots (CRPs), perform functional configuration, and manage testing of PLM solutions.
  • Proven experience with guiding clients through business process improvements.
  • Excellent interpersonal, organizational, presentation, and communication skills.
  • High commitment to exceed performance expectations.
  • Ability to write functional specification based on user requirements.
  • Senior enough to be able to independently handle client expectations.
  • Professional approach when dealing with internal and external customers.
  • Ability to maintain a positive attitude under stressful circumstances.
  • Willingness to travel as needed.
  • Preferred consulting experience in a similar role in a professional services firm or industry experience at a strategic level is required.
  • Previous experience working in IT companies.
  • In-depth knowledge of the technologies and systems relevant.
  • Creating a positive environment by monitoring workloads of the team while meeting client expectations.

SKILL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Communication: Proficient in English written and verbal communications. Excellent verbal and written communication skills to interact with clients, team members, and stakeholders.
  • Complex Project Management: Solution Architects are responsible for leading multiple complex projects, necessitating exceptional project management skills.
  • Thought Leadership: Providing thought leadership and industry expertise is critical in projects.
  • Client Acquisition: They should have strong business development skills to acquire new clients and expand existing relationships.
  • Mentorship and Coaching: Indirectly developing and coaching junior and mid-level consultants is a significant responsibility.
  • Strategic Vision: Solution Architects should contribute to the firm’s strategic vision and decision-making.
  • Executive Presence: The ability to interact effectively with senior client executives is important.
