raw.description:
Kindly note that this vacancy is for MIIS (Middlebury Institute of International Studies at Monterey) students only.

=================================================================

Hours: 15-20 hours per week

Location: home-based

Travel: none

Reporting to: Senior Project Officer

MIIS Students may be eligible for the Experiential Learning Fund (ELF). For more information please visit:

Are you a MIIS student with a unique internship idea based on your area of interest and expertise? Apply to any open MIIS internship posting, upload your resume, and outline your proposal in your cover letter.

CLEAR Global is an equal-opportunity employer, committed to having a diverse team where individuals of all backgrounds collaborate and learn from one another. We believe we can be most effective with diverse experience and expertise in our team. We recruit on merit, actively seek diverse applicant pools, and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. We do not discriminate on the basis of disability, age, gender identity and expression, national origin, race and ethnicity, religious beliefs, marital or parental status, or sexual orientation, and welcome all types of diversity.

Background

The Project Management Team at CLEAR Global handles a wide range of exciting projects, including language services, voice data collection, research, and technology initiatives.

The Project Management Intern - Medical Translations will collaborate closely with the Project Management Team in coordinating translation projects for our partners focused on health, ensuring that they are completed efficiently, in line with internal processes and partner expectations.

Objectives

The main objective of this internship is to support delivery of language services projects to CLEAR Global partners from the health sector, and to ensure linguists from our community are supported and remain engaged around these projects.

The role

The MIIS Project Management Intern - Medical Translations will support coordinating collaboration among different stakeholders, ensuring engagement, appropriate levels of expected output quality, and turnaround. They will also assist with internal processes necessary for the effective planning, coordination, and compliance of activities.

They will support the Project Management Team in coordinating translation projects, ensuring they are completed efficiently and within the expectations of CLEAR Global management and partners. They will coordinate collaboration among translators on specific tasks, providing engagement, appropriate levels of translation quality and turnaround, as well as track progress of translation tasks and credit linguists for their work.

Responsibilities

  • Manage specific language service projects as assigned by Project Officers;
  • Upload and download project files, run pre- and post-production checks;
  • Track project progress and delivery, keep project trackers up-to-date, and provide regular status updates to Project Officers;
  • Maintain an organized project environment across platforms, maintaining project records, files and databases as assigned;
  • Assist with building and managing translator teams, as well as general translator recruitment, as requested by Project Officers;
  • Maintain effective communication with translators throughout the project, ensuring that translators remain engaged throughout the project and have a clear understanding of project expectations;
  • Carry out translator communications around translation quality and turnaround, replying to translators’ messages, ensuring task pick-up, flagging issues, etc;
  • Handle other project management tasks as assigned;
  • Act in the best interest of the organization during the project period.

These roles and responsibilities are approximate and may change over time.

Qualifications

  • Current graduate student at the Middlebury Institute of International Studies (MIIS)
  • Excellent command of English. Knowledge of other languages is an advantage;
  • Previous experience in translation and/or interpreting (internships and volunteering are considered valid experiences) is desirable;
  • Previous experience working with non-profit organizations is desirable;
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
  • Strong writing skills in English;
  • Knowledge of CAT tools is a plus.

Requirements

This position is very dynamic. The right person is an energetic team player who agrees with CLEAR Global’s basic beliefs and values and can work remotely while interacting regularly with the international team.

  • Self-starter;
  • Strong organizational skills;
  • Analytical thinker able to transform ideas into tangible actions;
  • Understands that communication in the right language is key to improved humanitarian response;
  • Team player, collaborative, adaptable and self-motivated;
  • Interest in acquiring translation project management experience;
  • Ability to adapt to new technologies and learn new skills quickly;
  • Attention to detail

About CLEAR Global

CLEAR Global exists to help people get vital information, and be heard, whatever language they speak. We believe that everyone has the right to give and receive information in a language and format they understand. We work with nonprofit partners and a global community of language professionals to build local language translation capacity, and raise awareness of language barriers. Our network of over 200,000 community members translate millions of words of life-saving and life-changing information a year.

Core values

CLEAR Global employees and volunteers are people who believe passionately about the value of this work and take personal responsibility for achieving the mission. CLEAR Global’s mission and organizational spirit embody the core values established in its strategic framework:

  • Excellence: As the leading voice for communicating humanitarian information in the right language, CLEAR Global is a leader in the translation industry and in the non-profit sector.
  • Integrity: CLEAR Global believes that every person, whether it’s the people who we serve, our volunteers or our staff, has value, deserves respect and has inherent dignity.
  • Empowerment: CLEAR Global believes in using language to empower people around the world to control their own development and destiny.
  • Innovation: CLEAR Global recognizes and celebrates the power of innovation to address humanitarian and crisis issues around the world.
  • Sustainability: CLEAR Global recognizes that meeting our mission necessitates establishment and maintenance of a solid financial and organizational infrastructure.
  • Tolerance: Our staff and volunteers are highly knowledgeable and skilled; value each other, our partner and our recipients; create a supportive work environment; and, conduct themselves professionally at all times.

CLEAR Global may re-advertise the vacancy, cancel the recruitment, offer an appointment with a modified job description or for a different duration at its discretion.

PatientFi® is a technology-based, point-of-sale financing company in Irvine, CA that partners with healthcare providers to offer patients a friendly payment solution for out-of-pocket medical and dental procedures. The company serves various healthcare specialties, including plastic surgery, dermatology, ophthalmology, dentistry, fertility, and medical spas.   • Partner with the Practice Success Team to transition newly enrolled practices and drive rapid usage of the PatientFi platform

  • Collaborate with industry partners to obtain and convert Practice prospects

About the Company
Our client is a small U.S.-based consultancy that helps founders and marketing teams organize knowledge, processes, and AI-enabled workflows.
The team is lean and distributed, with Notion as its central operational hub and AI tools used to improve research, documentation, and execution.
About the Role
We are looking for a proactive Operations & Executive Assistant to keep projects, systems, and recurring responsibilities moving forward.
This is primarily an operations role. You will manage workflows in Notion, coordinate deadlines, maintain CRM and documentation, follow up with team members and contractors, and make sure operational details do not fall through the cracks.
You must already be comfortable using Notion and AI tools in your day-to-day work. We value people who can independently prioritize, identify blockers, research solutions, and take the next reasonable action without waiting for detailed instructions.
Why This Opportunity?
This role offers the opportunity to work directly with a U.S.-based founder while taking meaningful ownership of day-to-day operations, systems, and workflows.
You'll work hands-on with Notion, AI, project coordination, CRM, and process improvement, with the autonomy to help build better operational systems rather than simply execute a static administrative checklist.
What You'll Do
  • Manage projects, tasks, owners, due dates, dependencies, and recurring workflows in Notion.
  • Review overdue tasks, missing owners, unanswered requests, and stalled projects, following up proactively to keep work moving.
  • Turn disorganized requests into clear next actions and prepare concise updates on priorities, risks, blockers, and decisions needed.
  • Maintain Notion databases, CRM records, SOPs, internal documentation, and Google Drive resources.
  • Use AI tools for research, synthesis, documentation, meeting preparation, summaries, SOP creation, drafting, and routine operational support, validating outputs before use.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify, document, or improve recurring processes using Notion, AI, and better workflows.
  • Track executive commitments, approvals, follow-ups, and decisions; prepare agendas and convert meeting decisions into assigned tasks and deadlines.
  • Coordinate contractor onboarding, access, invoices, time logs, subscriptions, renewals, and basic administrative logistics.
  • Research vendors, tools, services, and operational questions and recommend practical next steps.
  • Support lightweight marketing operations such as scheduling approved content and uploading website, email, or social content when needed.
Qualifications
Required Qualifications
  • Experience in operations, project coordination, executive support, or a similar operational role.
  • Hands-on Notion experience with databases, tasks/projects, templates, properties, views, and filters.
  • Professional experience using AI tools in daily workflows for research, synthesis, documentation, drafting, or operational support.
  • Experience managing multiple projects, deadlines, recurring responsibilities, and CRM/project-management systems.
  • Strong organization, prioritization, attention to detail, and follow-through.
  • Ability to independently research problems, propose practical solutions, and adjust as priorities change.
  • Professional written and spoken English.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience supporting a founder, executive, or small professional-services business.
  • Experience reorganizing messy operational systems, maintaining SOPs, or improving recurring workflows.
  • Experience using AI to streamline recurring processes or administrative work.
  • Familiarity with Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, WordPress, or similar business tools.
  • Basic marketing operations or content scheduling experience.
How Success Is Measured
Success means projects and recurring responsibilities move forward without constant founder oversight; Notion and CRM remain organized and reliable; deadlines and blockers are proactively managed; and operational problems are surfaced with context and a proposed solution.
You will also help simplify or improve recurring processes using Notion, AI, and stronger operational workflows.
Why Join Us?
  • $1,800 – $2,200 USD/month.
  • Fully remote work in Latin America.
  • Direct exposure to the founder with significant autonomy and ownership.
  • Hands-on work with Notion, AI, systems, and process improvement.
  • Opportunity to build better operational systems rather than simply execute a static administrative checklist.
Important Notes
This is an operations-first position, not a traditional calendar-focused Executive Assistant role.
Candidates must already have practical Notion experience and professional experience using AI tools in their day-to-day work. We are looking for someone who can organize complexity, close loops, follow up confidently, and solve problems without constant supervision.

This is a remote/telecommute position.

As a CRO / Website Optimization Specialist, you will own a client's website and quiz-funnel experimentation roadmap from opportunity identification through execution and analysis. This is not a strategy-only position: you will formulate hypotheses, build and launch tests yourself, analyze performance, and determine what should happen next.

You'll have meaningful autonomy across Shopify, landing pages, quizzes, cart optimization, analytics, and experimentation tools. The right person combines strong CRO judgment with the technical confidence to make changes independently without relying on the client to finish or troubleshoot the execution.

Working hours are Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM EST.

Responsibilities

  • Own the website and quiz-funnel experimentation roadmap, prioritizing opportunities based on customer behavior, data, and potential conversion impact.
  • Turn conversion opportunities into clear hypotheses with defined success metrics and a rationale for why each test is worth running.
  • Personally build, QA, and launch A/B tests using Intelligems or comparable experimentation platforms.
  • Make Shopify front-end changes independently, including landing page updates, merchandising improvements, UX changes, and conversion-focused site enhancements.
  • Build and optimize landing pages rather than relying solely on designers or developers to execute your recommendations.
  • Improve quizzes and personalization funnels using Digioh or comparable tools to increase engagement and progression through the purchase journey.
  • Optimize cart and upsell experiences using Rebuy, Smart Cart, or similar Shopify conversion tools.
  • Use GA4 and platform-level analytics to evaluate website behavior, conversion performance, event tracking, and experiment outcomes.
  • Translate experiment results into clear next steps, including follow-up tests, rollouts, iterations, or changes in roadmap priority.
  • Troubleshoot unfamiliar website and platform issues independently using documentation, support resources, AI tools, and structured problem-solving.

Requirements

Must-Have:

  • 3-6+ years of hands-on experience in CRO, e-commerce website optimization, growth, or a closely related role, with flexibility for candidates whose experience demonstrates equivalent depth.
  • Strong practical knowledge of e-commerce conversion optimization, including funnels, customer journeys, merchandising, UX, and key conversion levers.
  • Hands-on Shopify front-end experience with the ability to make and troubleshoot website changes independently.
  • Proven ownership of A/B testing from opportunity identification and hypothesis creation through implementation, analysis, and next-step recommendations.
  • Hands-on experience with Intelligems or a comparable experimentation platform, plus working knowledge of GA4 and website conversion analytics.
  • Ability to personally build landing pages and conversion experiences rather than only producing briefs for designers or developers.
  • Strong judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to follow detailed written or video instructions carefully when working with sensitive website or company information.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience using Digioh for quizzes, funnels, personalization, or comparable conversion experiences.
  • Experience with Rebuy, Smart Cart, or similar Shopify upsell and cart-optimization tools.
  • Direct experience working with DTC e-commerce brands.
  • Experience optimizing subscription-based e-commerce businesses.
  • Previous experience in a role that combined strategic CRO ownership with substantial hands-on execution.

Role Title: Lawyer/Legal Writer

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging Lawyer/Legal Writers to participate in an evaluation and analysis opportunity focused on advanced AI system development for a customer project. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters.

This is an evaluative engagement: you will assess and analyze written legal content, not provide legal advice or representation. There is no attorney-client relationship, and your professional judgment about written argument is the core value. The focus is on those skills lawyers employ daily — discerning whether writing is precise, properly qualified, pitched to the appropriate audience, and free from unwarranted overstatement. Recognizing confidently stated but unsupported writing is central to the project.

Scope of Work

  1. Evaluate and compare multiple AI-generated written responses to legal and technical prompts for clarity, tone, and compliance with instructions.
  2. Assign analytical quality scores and compose detailed rationales for each assessment.
  3. Identify responses that sound authoritative but lack precision, contain overstatements, or present unsupported claims.
  4. Detect inconsistencies, ambiguities, or factual inaccuracies in digital content.
  5. Document findings and insights meticulously in online review platforms.
  6. Collaborate asynchronously with project managers and reviewers to ensure consistent evaluation standards.
  7. Work independently while managing deliverables and deadlines per project requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. English as a first language or fully equivalent written fluency.
  2. Qualifying law degree from a university in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Ireland, Australia, or New Zealand.
  3. Demonstrated experience drafting briefs, motions, memoranda, legal opinions, or regulatory submissions.
  4. Background in reviewing, editing, or supervising legal writing by junior lawyers, trainees, or paralegals.
  5. Strong ability to assess whether content is tailored appropriately for legal, regulatory, client, or public audiences.
  6. Exceptional attention to detail, critical analysis, and written communication skills.
  7. Experience with digital document review platforms or annotation tools is desirable; familiarity with model evaluation or RLHF is a plus but not required.

raw.description:
Position Summary

The Quality Review and Audit Lead Analyst supports the quality assurance and audit functions within Individual Dental Operations. This role conducts and coordinates internal and vendor quality reviews, analyzes audit results, develops reporting, identifies operational trends and risks, and works with business partners to improve processes, controls, and customer outcomes.

The Lead Analyst applies advanced knowledge of quality assurance, auditing, operational processes, and data analysis to complex assignments requiring independent judgment. The role supports daily audit operations, evaluates complex findings, maintains audit procedures and supporting documentation, and provides technical guidance to audit professionals and business partners.

This position also uses audit data and operational insights to identify compliance risks, reporting gaps, process deficiencies, and opportunities for continuous improvement, cost efficiency, and an enhanced customer experience.

Core Accountabilities and Responsibilities

Quality Review and Audit Execution

  • Conduct quality reviews and audits of internal operations and vendor-supported processes to evaluate adherence to established requirements, procedures, and controls.
  • Support daily audit activities, including review planning, case selection, evidence collection, documentation, analysis, and reporting.
  • Evaluate complex audit findings independently, engaging business owners or subject matter experts when additional technical interpretation is required.
  • Maintain complete and accurate audit documentation that supports findings, conclusions, and recommended actions.
  • Monitor audit activities and deliverables to ensure applicable regulatory turnaround requirements and internal expectations are met.
  • Support the collection and organization of evidence required for enterprise, regulatory, internal, or external audits.
  • Identify potential compliance concerns and escalate material findings or risks to the appropriate business owner.
  • Support calibration activities among internal audit professionals, operational teams, and vendor partners to promote consistent application of audit standards.

Quality Reporting and Analytics

  • Collect, validate, analyze, and summarize audit and quality data using approved systems and analytical tools.
  • Develop and maintain reports, dashboards, and supporting analyses that provide visibility into quality performance, audit findings, trends, and improvement opportunities.
  • Ensure recurring quality reports are accurate, timely, and aligned with the needs of operational leaders and business partners.
  • Compare quality results over time and evaluate progress against corrective actions, process improvements, and broader quality initiatives.
  • Identify patterns, recurring findings, emerging risks, and potential reporting gaps within audit and operational data.
  • Communicate analytical findings clearly to Quality Assurance, Operations, vendor, and business partners.
  • Partner with subject matter experts, team leads, and supervisors to define new data-collection requirements and address reporting gaps.
  • Develop new tracking and reporting capabilities as needed to support operating-model changes, business growth, or expansion.

Findings, Risk, and Corrective-Action Support

  • Analyze audit findings to determine potential root causes, business impacts, customer impacts, and compliance risks.
  • Distinguish isolated errors from recurring or systemic process issues requiring broader business attention.
  • Provide audit data and supporting evidence to business owners responsible for developing corrective or preventive actions.
  • Monitor identified issues and support reporting on remediation progress, recurring findings, and unresolved risks.
  • Proactively identify potential future risks, process weaknesses, or control gaps based on audit results and operational trends.
  • Engage appropriate business partners when findings require process, system, training, documentation, or control changes.
  • Present audit results and supporting analysis to internal stakeholders and vendor partners in a clear, factual, and constructive manner.
  • Support regulatory changes by helping identify necessary updates to audit tracking, workflows, job aids, standard operating procedures, and policies.

Process and Quality Improvement

  • Use audit results, quality data, and operational observations to identify practical process-improvement opportunities.
  • Lead or support project components involving enhancements to audit procedures, reporting, operational workflows, quality controls, or customer-facing processes.
  • Partner with Operations, Compliance, vendors, and other business teams to evaluate identified gaps and develop sustainable solutions.
  • Support the evaluation or development of new procedures and processes designed to mitigate compliance risk and improve customer outcomes.
  • Help assess whether implemented changes address the original finding and produce the intended quality improvement.
  • Recommend updates to controls, documentation, training, reporting, or monitoring based on audit evidence.
  • Contribute technical and process expertise to continuous-improvement initiatives across Individual Dental Operations.

Audit Standards, Procedures, and Team Support

  • Develop, maintain, and update audit procedures, standard operating procedures, job aids, workflows, and supporting documentation.
  • Help ensure audit standards and procedures remain aligned with current business processes and applicable requirements.
  • Provide technical direction and quality-related guidance to audit professionals and other team members.
  • Serve as a resource for questions involving audit methodology, data interpretation, documentation, and complex findings.
  • Support quality oversight activities for audit professionals while maintaining the role’s senior individual-contributor scope.
  • Promote consistency through knowledge sharing, calibration, and clear documentation of audit expectations.
  • Build effective working relationships with Quality Assurance, Operations, Compliance, vendor partners, and other matrix teams.
  • Manage multiple assignments and priorities independently while adjusting to changing business needs.

Qualifications

Required

  • Three or more years of relevant experience in healthcare operations, benefits, eligibility, claims, customer service, contact center operations, sales, quality assurance, or auditing.
  • Experience conducting quality reviews, audits, operational analyses, or comparable control activities.
  • Strong analytical, conceptual-thinking, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to collect, validate, analyze, and interpret quality or operational data.
  • Ability to identify patterns, evaluate complex findings, and communicate practical recommendations.
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to maintain accurate, supportable audit documentation.
  • Ability to manage multiple responsibilities and complete time-sensitive work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present findings to business and vendor partners.
  • Ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, and adjust priorities based on business needs.
  • Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively within a matrixed organization.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, particularly Microsoft Excel.
  • Ability to provide technical guidance and support to colleagues without formal supervisory authority.

Preferred

  • Three+ years of related experience in a healthcare or insurance environment.
  • Experience supporting Individual Dental, Individual and Family Plans, or another regulated health-benefits operation.
  • Knowledge of applicable federal and state regulatory requirements affecting individual insurance operations.
  • Understanding of Affordable Care Act and federal exchange requirements where relevant to the supported business.
  • Experience with internal, external, regulatory, or vendor quality audits.
  • Experience developing quality reporting, data-collection processes, audit analytics, or performance-tracking tools.
  • Experience supporting corrective actions, process improvements, or quality-improvement projects.
  • Experience with OnBase, Microsoft Access, Minitab, or comparable data and reporting tools.
  • Ability to travel occasionally based on business needs.

If you will be working at home occasionally or permanently, the internet connection must be obtained through a cable broadband or fiber optic internet service provider with speeds of at least 10Mbps download/5Mbps upload.

Who You Are

You are a strategic clinical operations leader with deep expertise in Medicare, value-based care, and care models for complex populations. You know how to translate population health and medical expense opportunities into scalable programs that improve outcomes, particularly for patients with complex medical, behavioral, and social needs. You are passionate about building a healthcare system that makes it easier for seniors to stay well, live independently, and get the care they need when they need it.

You are both a builder and an operator, able to guide teams from strategy through program design, implementation, and performance improvement. You see the potential for AI, data, and technology to transform care delivery and know how to set a compelling vision that brings clinical operations, product, and analytics teams together to achieve measurable impact.

Who We Are

Oasis Health Partners (Oasis) is an all-in-one partner for independent primary care practices. We focus on Medicare value-based care programs, including Medicare Advantage and MSSP, and surround practices with the practical support they need to deliver better care while building durable, independent businesses.

Our model helps physicians spend more time on proactive, high-value care for seniors while Oasis brings the data, tools and team to support them behind the scenes. We are building a fast-growing network of independent PCPs and IPAs, backed by leading healthcare investors and scaling into new markets as we expand our suite of provider solutions. We are committed to keeping independent medicine strong — and we are looking for people who want to build that future with us.

Together, we will boldly advance primary care for those that need it most. We are excited for you to join us on this journey. We invite you to be a part of Oasis, where you will discover we listen first, do the right thing, build together and go all in --- while having fun!

About You

Reporting to the Chief Clinical Officer, the Head of Clinical Strategy & Program Operations will help shape Oasis’s clinical and medical expense strategy and translate it into scalable, high-performing programs. You will help determine what Oasis should build, which populations and opportunities to prioritize, and which care-delivery models will produce the greatest impact.

Our clinical programs take three complementary forms: enabling independent primary care practices to deliver excellent care; providing direct-to-patient virtual support through Oasis teams; and partnering with specialized vendors to extend the services available to patients and practices. You will help build a cohesive portfolio across these models, ensuring each program has a clear purpose, operating model, and path to measurable impact.

You will build on our existing clinical programs, taking new ideas from concept through scale and partnering with frontline leaders to ensure they work in practice. You will lead a clinical programs team responsible for designing, implementing, and continuously improving programs in close partnership with Data, Product, Engineering, Market Operations, Patient Engagement and frontline care-delivery leaders.

This role requires a hands-on leader who can move fluidly from strategy to execution. Success will require product-oriented thinking and strong operational judgment - translating clinical needs into effective tools and workflows, driving implementation and performance, and ensuring programs work in practice for patients, providers, and frontline teams.

Key Responsibilities

Clinical and Medical Expense Strategy

  • Partner with the CCO to shape Oasis’s population health and total cost of care strategy.
  • Work with Finance and Analytics teams to identify the populations and opportunities where Oasis can most meaningfully improve outcomes while reducing avoidable medical expense.
  • Help determine which interventions and capabilities Oasis should build, buy, or deliver through partners.
  • Apply deep knowledge of Medicare, value-based care, and complex-care models to guide priorities and investment decisions.

Clinical Program Design and Operations

  • Lead and develop a team responsible for designing, launching, and improving a cohesive portfolio of scalable clinical programs spanning practice enablement, Oasis-delivered virtual support, and specialized vendor services.
  • Guide the development of program operating models, including workflows, staffing structures, roles, technology requirements, implementation plans, and KPIs.
  • Partner with Market Operations and Patient Engagement leaders to ensure programs are practical, integrated with frontline operations, and executed consistently.
  • Establish clear performance expectations and use clinical, operational, and financial results to guide continuous improvement.
  • Determine the right delivery model for each opportunity and ensure programs integrate effectively with independent primary care practices and complement services delivered by health plans and external partners.

Product, Data, and Technology Partnership

  • Lead the clinical design team in translating clinical and operational priorities into actionable requirements for Product, Data, Analytics, and Engineering.
  • Partner with subject-matter experts to evaluate emerging technologies, automation, AI, and external solutions based on clinical value, operational fit, and measurable impact.
  • Guide the development of capabilities such as risk segmentation, patient identification, next-best-action workflows, clinical decision support, and program-performance measurement.
  • Build strong cross-functional relationships and communicate strategies, decisions, and results clearly to executive leadership and other stakeholders.

Investment In Our Team 

We invest in the personal and professional success of our team. We take care of our people and offer robust benefits including 401K, medical, dental, vision and generous time off plans. We are committed to supporting your growth with a development program that starts with onboarding and continues throughout your career. As an inclusive, passionate and diverse team, you will partner with professionals who understand the importance of high-value, high-impact patient care.   

About You

  • 10+ years of experience in value-based care delivery, clinical operations, care-model development, healthcare strategy, or related roles.
  • Demonstrated track record of building new healthcare programs, products, or capabilities from the ground up - from identifying the opportunity and designing the solution through implementation, measurement, and impact at scale.
  • Deep understanding of clinical and operational levers that improve quality, medical expense, and patient outcomes in value based care.
  • Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex clinical and operational problems into clear solutions and measurable outcomes.
  • Experience partnering closely with Product, Analytics, and Technology teams to build data-, AI-, and technology-enabled healthcare solutions, with the judgment to distinguish compelling use cases from technology for technology's sake.
  • Experience leading multidisciplinary teams and working across clinical and non-clinical functions to deliver shared outcomes.
  • Undergraduate degree required; advanced clinical, business, public health, or related degree preferred.

The salary range listed reflects the full compensation range for this role level at Oasis and is designed to support growth over time. Actual offers may vary based on a candidate’s skills, experience, and alignment with the scope of the role. Offers near the top of the range are uncommon and generally reflect exceptionally deep, directly relevant experience.

At this time, we are unable to sponsor employment visas. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without a current or future visa sponsorship. This role is open to applicants currently residing in the United States.

★ PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR CV IN ENGLISH ★
Design Production Specialist
Location: Remote – Latin America
Eligible Countries: Colombia, Mexico, Argentina, Bolivia, Chile, Ecuador, Paraguay, Peru, Venezuela, Uruguay, Costa Rica, El Salvador, Guatemala, Honduras, Nicaragua, and Panama
Work Arrangement: Fully Remote
Employment Type: Full-Time Contractor
Industry: Manufacturing & Supply Chain / Retail Displays & Fixtures
Compensation: $8.00 – $15.00 USD/hour
English Proficiency: B2+/C1 English Required – Strong Professional Communication Skills


About the Company
Our client is a U.S.-based manufacturing company specializing in point-of-purchase displays and custom retail fixtures.
The company combines design, technical production, and manufacturing to transform creative concepts into functional, production-ready solutions for retail environments. The team works in a hands-on environment where design accuracy, production feasibility, visual quality, and collaboration between design and fabrication are essential.
About the Role
We are looking for a detail-oriented Design Production Specialist to prepare customer-supplied designs for final production in both 2D and 3D formats.
This role combines CAD modeling in SolidWorks with artwork preparation in Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop. You will ensure technical drawings, CAD models, and artwork files are accurate, properly documented, and ready for manufacturing while collaborating with production staff from design preparation through fabrication and assembly.
This opportunity is ideal for someone with a background in Industrial Design, CAD Design, Production Art, Prepress, or a related discipline who enjoys turning creative designs into production-ready files.
Why This Opportunity?
You'll combine CAD, industrial design, graphic production, and manufacturing while working on real-world physical products and custom retail environments. The role provides direct exposure to fabrication and assembly processes and an opportunity to further develop your SolidWorks and production-focused design expertise.
What You'll Do
CAD & Technical Design
  • Prepare and modify customer-supplied designs for production.
  • Create and update 2D and 3D CAD files using SolidWorks or similar CAD software.
  • Review technical drawings for accuracy and production readiness.
  • Make design adjustments based on manufacturing requirements and production feedback.
  • Maintain clear and accurate technical documentation.
Artwork & Production Files
  • Prepare and adjust artwork using Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop.
  • Review graphics and artwork to ensure files are production-ready.
  • Adjust layouts, dimensions, and production files as needed.
  • Maintain consistency between artwork and technical drawings.
Production Support & Documentation
  • Collaborate with production staff throughout fabrication and assembly.
  • Respond to production feedback and make necessary design or artwork revisions.
  • Ensure design files contain the information required for successful manufacturing.
  • Manage multiple CAD, artwork, and production files while maintaining accurate version control and documentation.
  • Support Bills of Materials (BOMs) when applicable.
Qualifications
Required Qualifications
  • Proficiency in SolidWorks or other CAD software.
  • Strong skills in Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop for artwork preparation and adjustments.
  • Background in Industrial Design, CAD Design, Production Art, Prepress, or a related field, through formal education or equivalent professional experience.
  • Ability to work with both 2D and 3D design files.
  • Strong attention to detail across technical drawings and graphic files.
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple files, revisions, and documentation.
  • B2+/C1 English proficiency with strong written and verbal communication skills for effective collaboration with U.S.-based team members.
  • Ability to communicate across departments and implement production feedback.
  • Flexible, dependable, and self-directed in a small, fast-paced remote environment.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with retail displays, point-of-purchase displays, store fixtures, merchandising systems, or branded environments.
  • Experience creating or organizing Bills of Materials (BOMs).
  • Previous experience as an Industrial Designer, Product Designer, CAD Designer, Prepress Technician, or Production Artist.
  • Interest in continuing to develop advanced SolidWorks skills.
How Success Is Measured
  • CAD models, drawings, and artwork files are consistently accurate and production-ready.
  • Customer designs are successfully translated into files that can be fabricated and assembled.
  • Technical drawings and graphics remain aligned throughout production.
  • Files, revisions, and documentation are organized and easy for production teams to use.
  • Production feedback and design changes are addressed accurately and efficiently.
  • Multiple projects are managed without sacrificing quality or attention to detail.
  • Communication with U.S.-based team members is clear and professional.
Why Join Us?
  • $8.00 – $15.00 USD/hour.
  • 100% remote opportunity from Latin America.
  • Work on real-world physical products and custom retail environments.
  • Combine CAD, industrial design, graphic production, and manufacturing in one role.
  • Collaborate directly with professionals involved in fabrication and assembly.
  • Develop deeper expertise in SolidWorks and production-focused design.
Important Notes
This is a production-focused design role, not a UX/UI or digital product design position. Candidates must have practical experience with CAD software and Adobe Illustrator/Photoshop and be comfortable working with both technical drawings and graphic/artwork files.
Experience with retail displays, store fixtures, or physical product manufacturing is highly valuable.
This is a remote/telecommute position.

raw.description:
Do you thrive at the intersection of creativity, systems thinking, and education? Have you led teams that turn abstract ideas into powerful, learner-centred programs? Are you skilled at translating complex industry insights into engaging curricula that scale globally? Do you find energy in managing projects from concept to launch while mentoring designers to deliver excellence? Are you passionate about building innovative learning experiences that shape the future of work and creativity across Africa? If so, then this might just be the role for you.

About ALX Africa

ALX Africa, a non-profit organisation under the ALX Foundation, is dedicated to unlocking the potential of Africa's digital future. Formerly part of Sand Tech Holdings, we've embarked on an independent journey to provide world-class tech skills training and career acceleration programmes. Our mission is to bridge the digital divide, upskill and reskill talent, and create a generation of innovative leaders. By 2030, we aim to empower 2 million Africans to secure sustainable tech careers.

With hubs in 8 cities across Africa and counting, we provide safe access to quality learning and a dedicated network of expert instructors. Our innovative programmes equip learners with the practical skills and knowledge needed to succeed in today's rapidly evolving tech industry. Through a combination of rigorous coursework, industry partnerships, and hands-on projects, we prepare our students for in-demand roles in software engineering, data science, and cybersecurity.

We achieve this by:

  • Providing young professionals with access to the most in-demand tech skills that will power the future.
  • Empowering the next generation of technology innovators, entrepreneurs, and business leaders through challenging, real-world coursework.
  • Building a lifelong, impactful community of tech professionals that support them at all stages of their career journey.

Our impact thus far:

  • 347k+ graduates since 2020
  • 257k youth in work
  • 31k youth starting own ventures
  • 60k youth in jobs created by entrepreneurs

Visit our website to learn more about our digital revolution.

Role Summary

The Senior Learning Experience Designer manages a team of Learning Experience Designers, oversees the creation of high-quality curricula, and ensures all programs align with our learning principles and strategic goals. You will act as both a coach and a project manager: guiding the design team, setting up workflows, ensuring timely delivery, and maintaining quality. You’ll collaborate with subject matter experts, industry partners, and internal teams to develop innovative programs in fast-growing fields, ensuring they are scalable, practical, and impactful.

Specific Responsibilities

  • Program & Curriculum Development

    • Oversee the design of new programs, ensuring learning experiences are practical, scalable, and industry-relevant.
    • Ensure curricula and assessments embody our learning design principles and align with the desired competencies.
    • Collaborate with industry subject matter experts and institutions to co-create cutting-edge program content.

    Team Leadership & Project Management

    • Lead and coach Learning Experience Designers, providing feedback and professional development in instructional design, media integration, and data-informed storytelling.
    • Manage design workflows, sprints, and retrospectives to ensure smooth delivery.
    • Oversee staffing allocations, project plans, and delivery calendars.
    • Establish strong review processes for content quality, accessibility, and pedagogical rigour.
    • Contribute to internal learning initiatives and workshops that strengthen the learning design function organisation-wide.

    Quality & Innovation

    • Ensure alignment with codified learning principles and institutional standards.
    • Incorporate learner, facilitator, and partner feedback into design iterations.
    • Experiment with new tools, technologies, and media formats (including AI) to enhance learner engagement and outcomes.
    • Drive a culture of innovation and continuous improvement across the design team.
    • Codify best practices, frameworks, and tools into playbooks and templates that enable consistent, high-quality design across programs.

    Data & Insights

    • Use learner performance data, completion metrics, and feedback to iteratively improve course design and delivery.
    • Develop dashboards or reporting frameworks in partnership with the data team to track learning effectiveness, engagement, and assessment validity.
    • Advocate for evidence-based decision-making in program and content iterations.

Skill Requirements

  • Experience

    • Proven track record in instructional design, learning experience design, or curriculum development.
      Experience leading teams of designers or educators, with strong coaching and mentorship abilities.
    • Demonstrated experience managing large-scale program development projects.
    • Experience working with or integrating AI-powered learning or assessment tools.
    • Beneficial: exposure to creative industries, digital media, or emerging technology fields.
    • Beneficial: Prior experience working in accredited or competency-based education programs is a plus.

    Skills

    • Expertise in instructional design methods, curriculum frameworks, and learner-centred design.
    • Strong systems thinking and ability to design learning experiences that balance pedagogy, technology, and operations.
    • Strong project management skills (e.g., sprint planning, retrospectives, pipeline tracking).
    • Excellent communication and collaboration skills for working with SMEs, partners, and cross-functional teams.
    • Ability to translate research and feedback into actionable program improvements.
    • Passion for innovation in learning, with comfort navigating ambiguity and complexity.
    • Familiarity with authoring tools (e.g. H5P) and learning management systems.
    • Strong storytelling, writing, and editing skills for creating engaging learning narratives.

Person Specification/Attributes

  • Courage: Willingness to speak up, challenge the status quo, and embrace new challenges.
  • Humility: Openness to learning, seeking help when needed, and a focus on serving others.
  • Adventure: A passion for setting ambitious goals, tackling difficult tasks, and finding joy in the journey.
  • Initiative: Proactive problem-solving, a sense of ownership, and a willingness to go above and beyond.
  • Resilience: The ability to bounce back from setbacks, persevere through challenges, and emerge stronger.

Employment Type

This is a full-time role.

Due to the considerable amount of virtual work and interaction with colleagues and customers across different physical locations internationally, it is essential that the successful applicant has the drive and ethic to succeed working in small teams physically but working independently virtually. Self-driving to communicate constantly using web collaboration and video conferencing is essential.

Job Description:

At Cloudera, we empower people to transform complex data into clear and actionable insights. With as much data under management as the hyperscalers, we're the preferred data partner for the top companies in almost every industry. Powered by the relentless innovation of the open source community, Cloudera advances digital transformation for the world’s largest enterprises.

About Cloudera

We are on a mission to make data and analytics easy and accessible to everyone. The work we do empowers any organization—from the world's largest enterprises to small nonprofits—to use data to solve some of the most complex challenges that impact businesses, communities, and lives.

At Cloudera, we are Customer Driven & People First. We believe in the power of our people because when we bring together bold ideas, collaboration, and purpose, we do not just imagine the future—we help build it.

The Role

This position will serve as a customer-facing, hands-on technologist with a track record of success. You will be the technical authority for Cloudera’s Enterprise AI portfolio, bridging the gap between complex data architectures and actionable AI business outcomes.

In this senior individual contributor role, you will own the technical sales strategy for the industry’s only platform bringing AI to data anywhere. You will not only demonstrate technology but also inspire customers to think bigger about their AI roadmap, ensuring they understand the value of the Open Data Lakehouse and Unified Data Fabric.

As a Solutions Engineer – Artificial Intelligence, you will:

  • Innovation Lifecycle - develop advanced techniques, solutions, and methodologies for customer core business process adoption

  • Research Engineering - assist domain experts, scientists, data scientists and technical engineers to develop AI Solutions to meet organizational objectives to include

  • Computational Engineering - work with clients to define objectives to curate data, algorithms, and outcomes; setup training pipelines, large-scale customer experiments, and evaluate models for production deployment

  • Research Consultation - consult with research scientists on the art of the possible and invention of new theoretical ideas, and or the practical application of theories to drive a computational engineering solution pipeline

  • Own the Technical Sales Lifecycle: Drive the technical sales process from introductory meetings and discovery through to post-sales success, upselling, and subscription renewals.

  • Architect AI Solutions: Design comprehensive solutions for customer needs using Cloudera technologies—specifically Cloudera AI, AI Inference, AI Studios, and AI Workbench—based on reference architectures and common patterns.

  • Strategic Evangelism: Present Cloudera’s product roadmap and vision to C-level executives (CIO, CTO, CDO), demonstrating how AI Agents and Cloud Bursting accelerate enterprise AI adoption.

  • Demonstrate Value: Create and deliver inspiring technical presentations and demonstrations that compel customers to say “yes” to Cloudera. Partner with Account Managers to articulate the true business value of our solutions.

  • Voice of the Customer: Interface with Product Management and Engineering to advocate for your customers' needs, transforming feedback from the field into actionable roadmap items.

  • Community Leadership: Participate in external publicity and evangelism, including speaking at conferences, writing blogs, and leading webinars to drive the narrative around trusted Enterprise AI.

We’re excited about you if you have:

  • Senior Experience: A minimum of 8 years of experience in a customer-facing role, ideally in a pre-sales or solutions engineering context.

  • AI & Data Proficiency: Deep experience with Data Engineering, Data Science, or Machine Learning. You understand the difference between Data Engineering and Data Science and can navigate the technical nuances of AI Assistants and Data Services.

  • Cloud Architecture Skills: Proficiency with one or more major cloud service providers (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and an understanding of hybrid deployment factors (public vs. private cloud).

  • Enterprise Governance: You understand that a Data Lake is more than just a storage dump. You are well-versed in the problems of Operations, Security, and Data Governance required to make AI safe for the enterprise.

  • Technical Versatility: Experience with Big Data, Data Warehousing (e.g., Iceberg), or Relational Databases, as well as familiarity with Unix/Linux environments.

  • Communication Mastery: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to whiteboard complex architectures and gather business requirements effectively.

  • Passion & Curiosity: A willingness to learn, a curiosity to discover new use cases for Cloudera technology, and a drive to make your customers successful.

What you can expect from us:

  • Generous PTO Policy

  • Support work life balance with Unplugged Days

  • Flexible WFH Policy

  • Mental & Physical Wellness programs

  • Phone and Internet Reimbursement program

  • Access to Continued Career Development

  • Comprehensive Benefits and Competitive Packages

  • Paid Volunteer Time

  • Employee Resource Groups

Job Description

This role is expected to perform both Reactive and Proactive work:

Proactive: Issue Prevention and Maintenance

  • Execute and validate patch management and system updates
  • Perform vulnerability remediation based on defined processes
  • Review and resolve monitoring alerts with minimal supervision
  • Perform system performance checks and basic optimization
  • Identify recurring issues and recommend improvement opportunities
  • Execute routine maintenance tasks to ensure system stability

Reactive: Responding to Alerts or Urgent Issues

  • Respond to urgent tickets and incoming client calls to diagnose and resolve technical issues via phone and remote tools
  • Provide support across varying shifts to support 24/7 coverage

This role is expected to handle and resolve the following with minimal assistance:

  • Complex workstation operating system issues (Windows and macOS)
  • Printer, peripheral, and basic network device issues (routers, switches, firewalls)
  • Standard and line-of-business application issues with deeper troubleshooting
  • Networking issues related to endpoint connectivity (DNS, DHCP, VPN, Wi-Fi)
  • User access and account-related issues

Job Qualifications

  • Strong experience troubleshooting Windows and macOS
  • 1–2+ years in Helpdesk / Technical Support / MSP environment
  • Ability to independently troubleshoot and resolve issues end-to-end

Working knowledge of:

  • Networking fundamentals (DNS, DHCP, connectivity, VPN basics)
  • Active Directory (user/account management)
  • Microsoft 365 (basic user and application support)
  • Experience with vendor coordination and escalation handling
  • Experience working in a Managed Service Provider (MSP) environment is strongly preferred

Job KPIs

  • CSAT: Client satisfaction scores based on ticket feedback
  • Utilization: Time accurately logged in the ticketing system
  • First-Touch Resolution: Tickets resolved in a single interaction
  • Average Handling Time (AHT): Average time spent on Tickets ( NEWLY ADDED)
  • Quality Score: Internal quality assessments by the training and QA team

Job Requirements

  • A home office set up that meets the following:
    • Computer: A working computer with a minimum of 8GB RAM and one of the following:
      • Windows 11 with an Intel i5 or i7 (8th generation or newer), or
      • AMD Ryzen 5 or 7 (2000 series or newer), or
      • macOS 12 or newer.
    • Internet: Stable internet connection with at least 5 Mbps download and upload speeds.
    • Audio Equipment: A quality headset with a noise-cancellation feature for meetings.
    • Mobile Device: A smartphone capable of installing the Microsoft Authenticator app.
    • Webcam: An HD webcam for video calls.
    • 2nd Monitor
    • UPS (Uninterruptible Power Supply) if using a desktop (Not needed if using a laptop)
  • A very strong cultural fit the ITS way (Our core values will be discussed during the interview)
  • Excellent command of the English language both spoken and written
  • Able to work full time 40 hours a week:
    • Reactive - Normal Business hours from 8:00AM to 5:00PM, Pacific Standard Time (PST) from Monday to Friday.
    • Proactive - Schedule will be finalized after the training period, with shifts outside the regular business hours.
  • Able to pass our online behavior and cognitive assessments.
  • Preferably have at least 2 of the following certifications: CompTIA A+, CompTIA Network+, CompTIA Security+, 3cx Basic Certified Engineer.
  • Able to provide NBI Clearance (for PH applicants).

  • Life Insurance

  • Paid Time Off (starts at 15 days per year)
  • Maternity/Paternity Leave
  • Paid US Holiday
  • Night Shift Bonus

raw.description:
Alignment Health is breaking the mold in conventional health care, committed to serving seniors and those who need it most: the chronically ill and frail. It takes an entire team of passionate and caring people, united in our mission to put the senior first.We have built a team of talented and experienced people who are passionate about transforming the lives of the seniors we serve. In this fast-growing company, you will find ample room for growth and innovation alongside the Alignment Health community. Working at Alignment Health provides an opportunity to do work that really matters, not only changing lives but saving them. Together.

Alignment Healthcare is a data and technology driven healthcare company focused partnering with health systems, health plans and provider groups to provide care delivery that is preventive, convenient, coordinated, and that results in improved clinical outcomes for seniors.

As a Data Scientist on the Pharmacy team, you’ll play a key role in evolving the analytical engine behind our pharmacy data and Part D Star measures within our Medicare Advantage line of business. This role focuses on applied data science to enhance the analytics, trending, and predictive modeling that inform pharmacy and Part D Star strategy. You'll help make tools more transparent, precise, adaptable, and actionable — incorpo-rating new methods, partnerships, and technologies along the way.

Job Duties/Responsibilities:

  • Partner with Pharmacy leadership to understand business problems, propose analytical solutions, and turn findings into clear, actionable takeaways for stakeholders.
  • Convert analytical models and business rules into scalable, production-ready tools.
  • Design dashboards and reporting that track Stars measure trajectories and intervention impact.
  • Build cut-point projection and simulation models to forecast Star Rating outcomes under varying performance and CMS methodology scenarios.
  • Build out prioritization rules, measure improvement models, and next-best-action (NBA) logic.
  • Analyze the financial impact of pharmacy and Star performance to help leadership prioritize investment and interventions.
  • Manage projects end to end – from problem definition through analysis, model building, validation, deployment support, and ongoing monitoring.
  • Collaborate with data and engineering teams to version, test, and deploy models using Git, CI/CD pipelines, and virtual machine (VM) environments.
  • Help standardize definitions, documentation logic, and reporting workflows to scale enterprise-wide AI-readiness.
  • Bring in new data sources, techniques, and emerging tools to continuously improve analytical capabilities.
  • Other duties as assigned by your manager.

Supervisory Responsibilities: N/A

Other:

  • Excellent communication, analytical and collaborative problem-solving skills.
  • Experience in building data science solutions and applying machine learning methods to real world problems with measurable outcomes.
  • Familiarity with time-series analysis or forecasting methods.
  • Solid data structures & algorithms background.
  • Strong programming skills in one of the following: Python, Java, R, Scala or C++
  • Demonstrated proficiency in SQL and relational databases.
  • Experience with data visualization and presentation, turning complex analysis into insight.
  • Experience in setting experimental analytics frameworks or strategies for complex scenarios.
  • Understanding of relevant statistical measures such as confidence intervals, significance of error measurements, development, and evaluation data sets, etc.
  • Experience with manipulating and analyzing complex, high-volume, high-dimensionality and unstructured data from varying sources

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior healthcare experience, ideally supporting Stars or Part D analytics.
  • Experience in Big Data processing technologies: Hadoop, Spark, Cosmos.

raw.description:
Who We Are:

Neurocrine Biosciences is a leading biopharmaceutical company with a simple purpose: to relieve suffering for people with great needs. We are dedicated to discovering, developing and commercializing life-changing treatments for patients with under-addressed neurological, psychiatric, endocrine and immunological disorders. The company's diverse portfolio includes FDA-approved treatments for tardive dyskinesia, chorea associated with Huntington's disease, classic congenital adrenal hyperplasia, hyperphagia in Prader-Willi syndrome, endometriosis* and uterine fibroids*, as well as a robust pipeline including multiple compounds in mid- to late-phase clinical development across our core therapeutic areas. For more than three decades, we have applied our unique insight into neuroscience and the interconnections between brain and body systems to treat complex conditions. We relentlessly pursue medicines to ease the burden of debilitating diseases and disorders, because you deserve brave science. For more information, visit neurocrine.com, and follow the company on LinkedIn, X, Facebook and YouTube. (*in collaboration with AbbVie)

About the Role:

Leads, performs, and oversees data management activities for assigned clinical studies for both in-house and outsourced clinical trial data; evaluates, develops, and implements data management processes, procedures, and tools to ensure business requirements are met; collaborates within Biometrics and with Medical, DSPV, Regulatory, QC, and other internal customers to ensure high quality data in support of regulatory submissions, safety reporting, and publications.

_

Your Contributions (include, but are not limited to):

  • Leads, performs, and oversees data management activities for clinical studies and/or clinical programs

  • Experience leading and supporting First-In-Human (FIH) clinical studies, including early protocol review, eCRF and database design, and alignment with dose-escalation and safety objectives

  • Hands-on management of data management activities for FIH studies, with emphasis on rapid data cleaning, near real-time safety data review, and support for frequent interim analyses

  • Close collaboration with Clinical Operations, Safety, and Biostatistics teams to support timely decision-making and governance in FIH studies

  • Performs hands-on clinical data management tasks to support clinical studies, including, but not limited to: reviewing study protocols, designing eCRFs, performing and coordinating user acceptance testing (UAT), documenting edit check specifications, QC’ing external data transfers, performing data quality checks/discrepancy review, and ensuring database lock activities are completed

  • Participate in, review, and lead development of policies, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), processes, and associated documents for data management; provide input on SOPs and processes in which data management is involved

  • Promote/advocate data management at inter- and intradepartmental meetings

  • Provide technical expertise to staff within Data Management, Biometrics, and other NBI departments; develop and execute training, including project-specific training, as necessary

  • Assist with responding to questions and findings from QA audits; ensure responses to Corrective Action Forms (CAFs) are closed out appropriately

  • Actively research current industry trends and share information with appropriate individuals at NBI

  • Recommend improvements to existing data management practices and procedures, including identifying, recommending, and implementing solutions for technology issues

  • Assist in the development of standardized documents within data management (both within and across projects/programs), including electronic case report forms and edit checks

  • Oversee screening, selection, validation, and implementation of data management software purchases and upgrades

  • Participate in selecting outsourcing vendors and review data management sections of proposals, including scope of work; monitor budgets as appropriate

  • Coordinate data management timelines for individual projects and well as clinical programs, including database lock, DSMB meetings, data review meetings, and monitoring CRO performance of data management tasks to ensure that timelines are met and that any resource issues are identified and resolved

  • Monitor in-house resources of assigned projects and identify potential deficiencies; work with supervisor to develop and implement a plan to overcome any obstacles

  • Ensure that appropriate quality control checks and audit procedures are implemented according to department SOPs

  • Run data review listings, issue queries, code Medical History and AE data using MedDRA dictionary and code Concomitant Medications using WHO Drug dictionary

  • Collaborate with database programmer to ensure NBI database standards, including CDISC/SDTM, are followed for both in-house and, if appropriate, outsourced projects

  • Identify areas of risk and proactively communicate issues and solutions to supervisor and/or appropriate colleagues and team members

  • Actively participate in data management-related NDA submission activities, as appropriate

  • Provide feedback, as requested, for performance evaluations. Identify strengths and areas for improvement for DM team members and work with supervisor to create a plan to develop team members

  • Perform other duties as assigned

Requirements:

  • BS/BA degree in computer science or a related discipline AND 8+ years of experience in the Pharmaceutical Industry, (either in-house/sponsor or CRO). OR

  • Master’s degree in computer science or a related discipline AND 6+ years of similar experience noted above OR

  • PhD in computer science or a related discipline AND 4+ years of similar experience noted above OR

  • 3+ years of experience serving in a supervisory or lead capacity

  • Qualified candidate must have a thorough understanding of the drug development process

  • Experience working with GCP and CDISC/CDASH/SDTM standards

  • Developing SOPs/Work Instructions, and following required FDA guidance documents

  • Must have hands-on clinical database programming skills, including SAS, SQL, and Medidata Rave Architect

  • Experience with Business Objects, Rave Targeted SDV and Batch Uploader preferred.

  • Experience with C# programming (custom functions) is a plus

  • Ability to communicate effectively both verbally and in writing

  • Has knowledge of best practices in the functional discipline and familiarity with the broader underlying concepts of related business disciplines

  • Works to improve tools and processes within functional area

  • Ability to work as part of and lead multiple teams

  • Exhibits leadership skill and ability, typically leads lower levels and/or indirect teams

  • Excellent computer skills

  • Excellent communication, problem-solving, analytical thinking skills

  • Sees broader picture, impact on multiple departments/divisions

  • Ability to meet multiple deadlines across a variety of projects/programs, with a high degree of accuracy and efficiency

  • Excellent project management skills

Neurocrine Biosciences is an EEO/Disability/Vets employer.

We are committed to building a workplace of belonging, respect, and empowerment, and we recognize there are a variety of ways to meet our requirements. We are looking for the best candidate for the job and encourage you to apply even if your experience or qualifications don’t line up to exactly what we have outlined in the job description.

_

The annual base salary we reasonably expect to pay is $130,800.00-$179,000.00. Individual pay decisions depend on various factors, such as primary work location, complexity and responsibility of role, job duties/requirements, and relevant experience and skills. In addition, this position offers an annual bonus with a target of 30% of the earned base salary and eligibility to participate in our equity based long term incentive program. Benefits offered include a retirement savings plan (with company match), paid vacation, holiday and personal days, paid caregiver/parental and medical leave, and health benefits to include medical, prescription drug, dental and vision coverage in accordance with the terms and conditions of the applicable plans.

raw.description:
What We Can Achieve Together

The Payroll Specialist, Europe will be a member of the Finance & Operations team and will be responsible for the end-to-end administration, coordination, and execution of payroll operations across multiple European countries and legal entities. The position ensures accurate, timely, and compliant payroll processing and serves as the primary liaison between Finance, Human Resources, employees, and external payroll providers. This position is part of Finance & Operations and focuses on payroll execution, payroll compliance, payroll controls, payroll accounting, and payroll vendor management.


We Are Looking For You


The successful candidate will combine strong payroll administration expertise with attention to detail, customer service, and the ability to manage multiple country payrolls simultaneously while handling confidential information and driving process improvements.


Essential Functions


  • Execute end-to-end payroll operations across multiple European countries.
  • Manage payroll calendars, deadlines, and processing schedules.
  • Coordinate payroll activities with external payroll vendors and accounting providers.
  • Review and validate payroll calculations, deductions, benefits, taxes, and statutory contributions.
  • Maintain payroll-related employee data, including salary, tax, social security, and bank information.
  • Ensure payroll changes related to hires, terminations, compensation changes, benefits, and leave are processed accurately.
  • Oversee time reporting and leave administration processes to ensure payroll accuracy.
  • Prepare and review payroll accounting reports and related adjustments.
  • Reconcile payroll reports to vendor reports, general ledger accounts, and local books.
  • Support payroll payments and related banking processes.
  • Maintain payroll documentation, audit trails, SOPs, and process controls.
  • Respond to employee payroll inquiries.
  • Coordinate payroll audits and compliance reviews.
  • Produce payroll reports, perform analysis, and identify process improvements.
  • Support additional Finance & Operations activities and projects related to payroll, employee compensation accounting, reconciliations, reporting, compliance, and process improvements as assigned.

Responsibilities & Scope


  • Own assigned payroll processes end-to-end and exercise independent judgment.
  • Coordinate payroll activities involving multiple countries, vendors, and stakeholders.
  • Handle confidential employee and compensation information with discretion.
  • Perform analysis, research, reconciliation, issue resolution, and follow-through.
  • Ensure compliance with TNC policies and applicable legal requirements.
  • Manage relationships with payroll providers and related vendors.
  • Contribute to payroll process improvement and standardization across Europe.
  • Support broader Finance & Operations initiatives and special projects as needed, particularly where payroll, employee compensation, compliance, reporting, or process improvement activities intersect with Finance responsibilities.
  • Complete other duties within the scope of the role assigned by the supervisor.

Minimum Qualifications


  • Bachelor’s degree and 2 years related experience or equivalent combination.
  • Experience coordinating administrative processes.
  • Experience generating reports and interpreting data.
  • Experience in business writing, editing, and proofreading.
  • Experience organizing time and managing diverse activities to meet deadlines.
  • Experience working across teams and communicating with a wide range of people.

Desired Qualifications


  • Professional working proficiency in German and English is required. Additional languages are a plus.
  • Multi-cultural or cross-cultural experiences are appreciated.
  • Ability to analyze information for planning activities and solving problems.
  • Ability to use technology to achieve desired results.
  • Excellent customer service skills and focus.
  • Experience interpreting guidelines to achieve desired results.
  • Knowledge of payroll administration, payroll accounting, payroll compliance, and payroll vendor management.
  • Experience working with multi-country European payroll.
  • Experience working with Workday or similar HRIS/payroll systems.
  • Strong organizational skills, accuracy, and attention to detail.

The Nature Conservancy’s mission is to protect the lands and waters upon which all life depends. Our Long-Term Services and Supports (LTSS) Clinical Support team is looking for a new Member Support Coordinator!

We are seeking a compassionate, organized, and member-focused Member Support Coordinator who is passionate about helping TennCare members access the long-term services and supports they need to remain safely and independently in their homes and communities. In this role, you will serve as a key point of contact for individuals seeking information about the CHOICES program, helping members and their family representatives understand available services and navigate the screening and referral process.

As part of our LTSS Clinical Support team, you will conduct CHOICES screenings telephonically, manage incoming referrals, and engage directly with members and their authorized representatives by phone. You will play an essential role in gathering information, assessing potential program eligibility, educating individuals about available LTSS options, and ensuring timely progression through the screening process. This position requires strong communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to build trust with individuals who may be facing significant health, functional, or caregiving challenges.

To be successful in this role, you will need excellent customer service and organizational skills, the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment, and a commitment to delivering a positive member experience. This position is ideal for someone who enjoys helping others, thrives on meaningful member interactions, and is motivated by improving access to quality long-term services and supports for TennCare members across Tennessee.

Note:

  • Must live in the State of Tennessee
  • Fully remote role
  • Must hold a Masters in Social Work (LCSW, LMSW, or LAPSW) OR Registered Nurse (RN) OR Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN) license.

  • Masters in Social Work (LCSW, LMSW, or LAPSW) OR Registered Nurse (RN) OR Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN)

Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

The Role

The Senior Lead Release Train Engineer (Sr. RTE) is an experienced servant leader, enterprise coach, and execution partner for a highly complex Agile Release Train or multiple closely aligned trains within Lumen’s Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). You will be responsible for driving ART maturity, improving flow, coaching leaders and teams, and ensuring complex delivery commitments are translated into executable plans.

The Senior Lead RTE is expected to operate with greater independence, judgment, and cross-functional influence. This role supports more complex value delivery environments, mentors RTEs and Scrum Masters, strengthens operating standards. Apache Spark Developer – Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
